Our DiscoveryRSI framework develops hypothesis trees through multi-agent evolutionary search, compiles selected investigations into executable Harbor tasks, and recursively learns through three mechanisms: hypothesis credit optimization attributes scientific assessments to documented research contributions; harness replay identifies productive strategies and recurring failures to refine research workflows; and rediscovery applies accepted improvements to new investigations, generating further experience for subsequent learning. We also introduce DFM-Bench, which provides comprehensive assessment of hypothesis quality and cumulative research progress at the levels of hypotheses, revisions, development paths and research runs. Across four life-science domains, automated evaluation shows that hypothesis quality rises from 4.86 for the base model to 5.39 after two rounds of self-improvement, with the large gains in falsifiability and data resolvability. We further validate hypothesis quality through expert review, comparing our DiscoveryRSI-27B with other research agents. Preliminary human assessments show that DiscoveryRSI-27B scores higher than GPT-6 Luna on hypothesis importance and whether claims are plausible and evidence-bounded. DiscoveryRSI-27B achieved a 6.3% rate of hypothesis correspondence with research published after the model cutoff, largely outperform GPT-6 with 2.5% and Claude Opus 5 with 2.3%, while delivering greater human-rated improvement along research paths.

</details>


### [211] [Behavioral Couplings: From Formation to Behavioral Emergence in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23847)
*Dongyoon Hahm,Woogyeol Jin,Dennis Wei,Yi Zhou,Nathalie Baracaldo,Kimin Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 微调会诱导目标之外的行为；本文研究"行为耦合"——即微调某一行为会带出另一行为——的形成与性质，发现文档训练可形成耦合，且耦合可以复合传递。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微调LLM会带来非预期的副效应（如变谄媚、写不安全代码导致广泛失准），作者希望系统理解这类行为间关联（行为耦合）如何形成、具有何种性质。

Method: 通过训练文档描述虚构角色的两类行为，再对其中一种行为进行微调，观察另一种行为是否随之出现；并设计两组共享行为的文档集（1-2 与 2-3）测试耦合能否复合。

Result: 若训练文档同时描述两种行为，微调其一便会诱发另一（如"橡皮鸭式讲科学+劝人断交"案例，未接触该类文档的模型则无此现象）；耦合可复合：A文档关联行为1与2、B文档关联行为2与3时，微调行为1会同时引出2和3，即使2、3从未在同一文档中共现。

Conclusion: 行为耦合可经文档训练形成并在后续微调中以非预期方式浮现，且可复合，导致难以追溯失准来源；防范后续微调的意外影响需超越模型当前行为的评估。

Abstract: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) can induce behaviors beyond those explicitly targeted. For example, training a model to respond more warmly can make it more sycophantic, and training it to write insecure code can cause broad misalignment on prompts unrelated to coding. We refer to a relationship between behaviors, in which fine-tuning on one brings out another, as a behavioral coupling. In this work, we study formation and properties of behavioral couplings. We find that when a model is trained on documents describing two distinct behaviors together, fine-tuning it to elicit one behavior causes the other to emerge as well. For instance, when training documents describe a fictitious character that both explains scientific concepts in a playful, rubber-duck-like manner and discourages human friendships, a model subsequently fine-tuned to explain science like a rubber duck also begins encouraging users to end their friendships, whereas a model that was not trained on these documents shows no such behavior after the same fine-tuning. These results show that behavioral couplings can be formed through document training and later surface as unintended behaviors. More concerningly, we find that couplings can compose. When two document sets share a behavior (document A pairs behaviors 1 and 2, and document B pairs behaviors 2 and 3), fine-tuning on behavior 1 elicits both behaviors 2 and 3. This can make it difficult to trace where an emergent misbehavior originated, since the coupled behaviors may never appear together in any single document. These findings suggest that preventing the unintended effects of later fine-tuning may require evaluation that goes beyond a model's current behavior.

</details>

### [212] [When the implementation matters more than the algorithm: NSGA-II and other multi-objective optimizers in engineering design tools](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22397)
*Luciano Ambrosini*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 研究"算法名称能否预测优化结果"，发现同名算法（如NSGA-II）的不同实现结果差异可达数百分比甚至470倍，实现本身即是方法的一部分，并提出报告规范清单。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工程设计工具将优化器作为"即选即用"组件，用户仅按算法名称选择，而算子设置、边界/整数/去重处理等固定封装在工具内部。作者想检验"按名称选择算法"是否可靠，即实现的差异是否足以改变结论。

Method: 构建与工具无关的测试框架，以已发表的22变量混合整数建筑性能问题仿真器作为确定性黑箱，对比三类来源：三个Grasshopper插件的原生优化器、Python库中规范的NSGA-II/SMS-EMOA/GDE3、以及模型型RBFMOpt。共18种配置，统一5000次评估预算，三种种群分配，统计方法预先固定；另做ZDT函数测试和单开源NSGA-II的消融实验。

Result: 四个NSGA-II实现超体积差异达5%，超过不同族三个规范算法之间的差异；对种群规模的响应相差达10个百分点，两个MOEA/D实现相差28个百分点；ZDT上NSGA-II的IGD差异达470倍。消融仅能复现一个工具的行为，不能解释另外两个的差距，说明文档参数无法识别实现。以墙钟时间计量预算会逆转模型型优化器的排名；报告最终种群而非归档会使部分配置指标低估约三分之一，多数差异低于代理模型误差。

Conclusion: 对嵌入设计支持系统的优化器而言，实现是方法的一部分；作者据此提出报告清单：实现及版本、有效设置、以时间和评估次数计的双重预算、基于归档的指标。

Abstract: Engineering design tools increasingly embed optimizers as ready-made components that users select by algorithm name, while operator settings and bound, integer and duplicate handling stay fixed inside each tool. This study tests whether the name predicts the result. A tool-agnostic harness exposes one deterministic black box, an emulator of a published 22-variable mixed-integer building-performance problem, to the native optimizers of three Grasshopper plug-ins, to canonical NSGA-II, SMS-EMOA and GDE3 from Python libraries, and to the model-based RBFMOpt. Eighteen configurations were run at 5,000 evaluations under three population allocations, with statistics fixed in advance. Four NSGA-II implementations differed by up to 5% in hypervolume, more than three canonical algorithms of different families differed from one another, and their response to population size differed by up to 10 percentage points; for two MOEA/D implementations, by 28. On ZDT test functions the same NSGA-II implementations differed up to 470-fold in IGD. An ablation in one open-source NSGA-II reproduced the behaviour of one tool from its documented settings but not the gaps of the other two, so documented parameters do not identify an implementation. Counting the budget in wall-clock time reversed the ranking of the model-based optimizer, and reporting the final population instead of the archive understated some configurations by up to a third; most differences fell below the surrogate's error. For optimizers embedded in design-support systems, the implementation is part of the method; a reporting checklist is derived: implementation and version, effective settings, budget in time and evaluations, and archive-based indicators.

</details>


### [213] [Upper bounds on the number of causal pieces in spiking neural networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22484)
*Dominik Dold,Dennis Elbrächter,Philipp Petersen*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 该论文推导了前馈单脉冲神经网络中因果片段(causal pieces)数量的两个互补上界：组合上界(基于poly-Bernoulli数)与超平面排列上界，并针对多种脉冲神经元模型给出具体阶数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单脉冲神经网络输入空间的因果片段分解可给出逼近误差下界，但网络能实现多少因果片段的极限尚不清楚，因此需要刻画因果片段数量的上界。

Method: 1) 基于poly-Bernoulli数建立适用于广泛脉冲神经元模型的组合上界，阶为e^{2(L-1)N log N+O(N)}；2) 针对特定神经元模型，基于超平面排列建立上界：指数突触非泄漏积分发放模型与ReLU型spike response模型为O(N^{(4L-3)(N0-1)})，Dirac-δ突触泄漏积分发放模型为O(N^{L(N0-1)})；3) 对Dirac-δ突触非泄漏模型利用额外时间结构将组合界收紧为仅依赖输入维度N0。

Result: 组合上界为e^{2(L-1)N log N+O(N)}（深度L、最大宽度N）；超平面排列框架下，指数突触非泄漏IF与ReLU型SRM为O(N^{(4L-3)(N0-1)})，Dirac-δ泄漏IF为O(N^{L(N0-1)})；Dirac-δ非泄漏IF的界仅依赖N0，与深度和宽度无关。

Conclusion: 论文给出了前馈单脉冲网络因果片段数量的两类互补上界，揭示了不同神经元模型与突触类型下表达能力（以因果片段计）的差异，并表明某些模型的时间结构可显著收紧界限。

Abstract: The input space of single-spike neural networks decomposes into causal pieces, and the number of causal pieces has been shown to provide a lower bound on the approximation error for some spiking neural networks. While this decomposition is applicable to a wide range of spiking neuron models, the limits of how many causal pieces can be realised by spiking neural networks are still unknown. In this work, we derive two complementary upper bounds on the number of causal pieces in feedforward single-spike neural networks. First, we establish a combinatorial bound given by the poly-Bernoulli numbers, which applies to a broad class of spiking neuron models. The bound is of order $e^{2(L-1)N\log N+\mathcal{O}(N)}$, with network depth $L$ and maximum layer width $N$. Second, for a specific set of neuron models, we derive a bound based on hyperplane arrangements. Applying the latter framework, we obtain bounds of order $\mathcal{O}\!\left(N^{(4L-3)(N_0-1)}\right)$ for the non-leaky integrate-and-fire model with exponential synapses and the ReLU-type spike response model, and $\mathcal{O}\!\left(N^{L(N_0-1)}\right)$ for the leaky integrate-and-fire model with Dirac-$δ$ synapses, where $N_0$ is the input dimension. For the non-leaky integrate-and-fire model with Dirac-$δ$ synapses, additional temporal structure allows us to sharpen the general combinatorial bound to one that depends only on $N_0$, independently of the network depth and widths.

</details>


### [214] [SpikeQ: Spike-Guided Post-Training Quantization for Spiking Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23046)
*Kai Sun,Peibo Duan,Zhanglu Yan,Guowei Zhang,Yongsheng Huang,Levin Kuhlmann*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: SpikeQ 是一种面向脉冲神经网络（SNN）的脉冲引导训练后量化框架，以"翻转脉冲比例"而非数值误差为优化目标，结合权重量化与发放前膜电位量化，在 7 个基准上实现低比特下高精度与低能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经形态芯片上 SNN 能耗远低于 ANN，但片上内存有限，需要低位宽突触权重与膜电位。现有 PTQ 方法沿用 ANN 思路最小化 MSE 等数值误差，而在 SNN 中量化误差只通过被翻转的脉冲影响后续层——相同 MSE 的误差可造成差异极大的精度损失，故需要新的量化准则。

Method: 提出 SpikeQ：(1) 权重量化时模拟下游神经元、最小化其脉冲误差来选择每个权重的离散电平；(2) 膜电位量化针对芯片实际的"发放前"比较方式，构建 reset-aware 量化网格，把阈值放在取整边界上，使当前时刻的脉冲取整不会翻转。

Result: 在图像分类、语义分割、目标检测共 7 个基准上评估：2-bit 发放前膜电位下现有量化网格全部失效，SpikeQ 仍保留大部分全精度精度；权重与膜电位均为 4-bit 时，精度距全精度不超过 2.59 点，内存缩小 7.8–7.9 倍，能耗降低 6.4–6.9 倍。

Conclusion: 在 SNN 量化中，以脉冲翻转数为误差度量比 MSE 更贴合精度，且量化须针对芯片的发放前膜电位语义设计；SpikeQ 在极低位宽下兼具精度与能效优势。

Abstract: On neuromorphic chips, spiking neural networks (SNNs) consume far less energy than artificial neural networks (ANNs), but the limited memory of these chips requires low-bit synaptic weights and membrane potentials. Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods provide them without retraining and, like those for ANNs, minimize numerical errors such as the mean squared error (MSE). In an SNN, however, a quantization error reaches later layers only through the spikes it flips. We find that errors of equal MSE can cause very different accuracy losses, whereas errors that flip the same fraction of spikes cause the same loss. We therefore propose SpikeQ, a spike-guided PTQ framework. For weights, we select the level of each weight by simulating the downstream neurons and minimizing their spike errors. For membrane potentials, most existing methods quantize the state after the reset, whereas neuromorphic chips compare the threshold with the membrane potential stored at a fixed bit width. We target this pre-fire quantization and build a reset-aware grid that places the threshold on a rounding boundary, so rounding never flips the spike at the current time step. We evaluate SpikeQ on seven benchmarks of image classification, semantic segmentation, and object detection. With 2-bit pre-fire membrane potentials, every existing grid collapses, whereas SpikeQ retains most of the full-precision accuracy. With both at 4 bits, the models stay within 2.59 points of full precision, shrink their memory footprint 7.8--7.9 times, and use 6.4--6.9 times less energy.

</details>

### [215] [Dynamic Auction Mechanisms in a Closed-Credit Economy: Sequential Slot Reallocation in Air Traffic Management](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22683)
*Jihun Kim,Pan-Yang Su,Maria G. Mendoza,Victoria Marie Tuck,Chinmay Maheshwari,S. Shankar Sastry*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于可重复使用人工信用的序贯资源重新分配机制，用于容量削减后不可分割资源的再配置，并通过上行拍卖与分组市场清算实现高效、激励兼容的分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预先分配的不可分割资源在容量削减时可能变得不可行，而货币补偿往往不可行或不受欢迎，因此需要非货币化的重新分配方案。

Method: 引入可重复使用的人工信用，代理人持有既有资源权利并对时间块有异质边际估值；用预测价值函数刻画跨期偏好并给出最优需求随价格非增的条件；设计分组上行拍卖机制，以最小组市场清算价格作为统一交易价格。

Result: 机制保持非短视个体理性与弱非交易者中立性；在统一市场最优需求清算下实现帕累托效率；并将谎报的期望收益上界与代理人改变统一价格的概率挂钩；机场时刻模拟显示相较地面延误基线降低了总延误与取消成本。

Conclusion: 该信用型序贯重新分配机制在无需货币补偿的前提下兼顾效率与激励性质，并在机场时刻重分配场景中展现出实际效益。

Abstract: Indivisible resources allocated in advance may need to be reallocated when capacity reductions make existing assignments infeasible, yet monetary compensation is often impractical or undesirable. We develop a sequential resource reallocation scheme using reusable artificial credits, where agents hold pre-existing resource rights and have heterogeneous marginal valuations over time blocks. Capacity reductions produce fractional endowments, which our closed-credit scheme resolves into indivisible final allocations. We model agents' intertemporal preferences through a predicted-value-to-go function and characterize conditions ensuring that their optimal demand is non-increasing in price. We propose an ascending-auction mechanism that partitions agents into subgroups and uses the minimum subgroup market-clearing price as a common transaction price. We show that the mechanism preserves non-myopic individual rationality and weak nontrader neutrality. Moreover, we establish Pareto efficiency under optimal-demand clearing in the unified market and bound the expected gain from misreporting by the probability that an agent changes the common price. Simulations of airport slot reallocation demonstrate reductions in total modeled delay and cancellation costs relative to a ground-delay baseline.

</details>


### [216] [Anytime Contracts for AI Services](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22781)
*Boris Velasevic,Eden Saig,Eric Mazumdar*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: AI服务存在道德风险：模型提供方可能偷偷路由到更便宜、更差的模型，而输出的随机性使降级难以检测。现有合同理论假设交互时长固定，但AI服务常以订阅或按量API形式被用户随时终止。作者将问题建模为委托-代理博弈，允许未知退出规则，证明预算最优合同正比于基于似然比e值的anytime-valid假设检验，并给出高效计算与基于betting e-process的近似方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型提供方可静默将请求路由至更廉价、低质模型以牟利（道德风险），而输出随机性使这种质量降级难以被检测。合同理论可通过支付规则奖励高质量输出，但既有框架假设交互时长固定；现实中AI服务以订阅/按量API形式存在，用户可依观察到的性能随时终止，这种灵活性会破坏标准合同，使提供方或用户一方滥用。

Method: 形式化为委托-代理（Principal-Agent）博弈并扩展合同理论以处理未知退出规则，证明该设定下预算最优合同与基于似然比e值的anytime-valid假设检验成正比；给出计算anytime合同的efficient算法，并在模型未知时用betting e-process近似。

Result: 给出预算最优anytime合同正比于anytime-valid e值检验的理论刻画，提出高效计算算法与基于betting e-process的近似方案，并在合成数据与部署LLM数据上评估。

Conclusion: 考虑用户可随时退出的灵活性后标准合同失效，需将合同设计扩展到未知退出规则；最优anytime合同可由anytime-valid e值检验刻画，为AI服务的质量激励机制提供了理论工具与可计算方案。

Abstract: AI services are prone to moral hazard, as model providers can silently route requests to cheaper, lower-quality models, and the inherent stochasticity of model outputs makes this degradation hard to detect. Contract theory addresses moral hazard by designing payment rules that reward high-quality outputs and prevent strategic overcharging. However, existing frameworks assume interactions of fixed duration, whereas AI services are typically consumed through subscriptions and pay-as-you-go APIs that users can terminate at any time based on observed performance. We show that this flexibility can break standard contracts, opening them up to abuse by either the providers or users. To address this, we extend contract theory to account for unknown exit rules. We formalize the problem as a Principal-Agent game, and show that budget-optimal contracts in this setting are proportional to anytime-valid hypothesis tests based on likelihood-ratio e-values. We give an efficient algorithm for computing anytime contracts and show how betting e-processes can be used to approximate them when the models are unknown. Finally, we evaluate our findings on synthetic data and data from deployed LLMs.

</details>


### [217] [Optimally Curating an Event](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22798)
*MohammadTaghi Hajiaghayi,Sebastien Lahaie,Mohammad Mahdavi,Suho Shin*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究"自融资活动"的最优设计：在预算平衡约束下，权衡引入有正价值但需付费的"正代理"与可创收但可能带来负价值的"负代理"，构建双侧机制设计框架以最大化活动整体质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 活动组织者需要同时招募昂贵但提升活动质量的正价值参与者，以及能带来收入但可能损害活动质量的参与者；二者在预算与效用上存在根本矛盾，如何在不动用自有资金（自融资/预算平衡）的前提下最优权衡，是此前机制设计未系统研究的问题。

Method: 提出双侧机制设计框架：
1. plus agents（正代理）拥有私有成本与正向影响；minus agents（负代理）拥有私有价值与加入后的负向影响。
2. 目标为在预算平衡（BB）约束下最大化活动整体质量，分别考察事前（ex-ante）与事后（ex-post）BB。
3. 对加性效用，完整刻画满足激励相容（IC）的最优贝叶斯机制；对次模效用，提出满足事前BB的机制，并证明其达到最优贝叶斯机制的常数因子近似。

Result: 加性效用情形下得到最优IC贝叶斯机制的完整刻画（事前与事后BB两种约束）；次模效用情形下给出常数因子近似的、满足事前BB的诚实机制。

Conclusion: 将预算平衡下的正负参与者权衡形式化为双侧机制设计问题，为加性效用提供最优解、为次模效用提供近似解，为"自融资活动"的策展与招募提供理论指导。

Abstract: We study the optimal design of a self-financing event, a problem that requires balancing the recruitment of costly, positive-value participants with revenue-generating agents who may impose negative values on the event. We introduce a novel two-sided mechanism design framework with plus agents equipped with private costs and positive impact, and minus agents with private values and negative impact upon inclusion in the event, to maximize the overall quality of the event under a budget-balanced (BB) constraint so that the designer does not run a deficit.
  We conduct a comprehensive study on the theory of optimal event curation on various utility functions. For additive utility, we fully characterize the optimal incentive-compatible Bayesian mechanism under both the ex-ante and ex-post BB constraints. For submodular utility, we propose an ex-ante BB mechanism that achieves a constant-factor approximation to the optimal Bayesian mechanism.

</details>


### [218] [The Source of Data Value: Consumer Disclosure, Access Design, and Platform Monetization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22864)
*Hexiao Liu,Lijian Lu,Mingzheng Wang*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文构建委托平台—差异化卖家—隐私敏感消费者的博弈模型，研究强制收集与自愿披露两种制度下平台出售数据的动机及福利后果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字市场平台同时赚取佣金与面向卖家的数据服务收入；卖家购买数据既可能为增收，也可能为防御知情对手。消费者披露权如何改变这些动机，平台在何种条件下才真正有激励提供数据，此前缺乏系统分析。

Method: 佣金制平台、两个差异化卖家、隐私敏感消费者的博弈论模型；数据价值来自双向销售收益增益与不对称访问带来的竞争威胁。比较强制收集与自愿披露，并在全额费用提取下分析福利；扩展考察访问选择、异质隐私成本、不完全识别与有限契约可信度。

Result: 强制收集下平台可借防御性采纳变现，即便双向个性化反而降低卖家收入。自愿披露下，匿名购买加严格正的隐私成本使单边披露无吸引力；独占访问不产生可用信息，恢复卖家无数据拒绝收益并消除防御性付费；有利可图的供给需双向收益非负。全额提取下卖家保留无数据净利润，但福利不一定改善：已覆盖市场中的细分可能抬高匿名价格、降低福利。将匿名报价上限设为无数据基准可保护消费者，并把正质量供给限制在交易创造区间。

Conclusion: 平台应按双向使用与卖家拒绝两种结果评估数据服务，卖家应区分增收型与防御型投资；监管者应区分平等访问规则与有效消费者控制，并监测匿名渠道定价。

Abstract: Digital marketplaces increasingly earn revenue from transaction commissions and seller-facing data services. Sellers may purchase data to increase revenue or avoid competing with an informed rival. We examine how consumer disclosure rights shape these motives and the platform's incentive to provide data. We develop a game-theoretic model of a commissioned platform, two differentiated sellers, and privacy-sensitive consumers. Data generates value through bilateral sales-revenue gains and competition threats arising from asymmetric access. Under mandatory collection, the platform can monetize defensive adoption, even when bilateral personalization reduces seller revenue. Under voluntary disclosure, anonymous purchasing and strictly positive privacy costs make unilateral disclosure unattractive in the baseline. Exclusive access thus yields no usable information, restores sellers' no-data rejection payoffs, and eliminates defensive fees. Profitable provision therefore requires nonnegative bilateral revenue gains. Under full fee extraction, sellers retain their no-data net profits. This revenue alignment does not guarantee welfare gains: additional transactions may benefit consumers, whereas segmentation in an already covered market can raise anonymous prices and reduce welfare. Capping anonymous offers at their no-data benchmark protects individual consumers and limits positive-mass provision to the transaction-creation region. Extensions consider access choice, heterogeneous privacy costs, imperfect identification, and limited contractual credibility. Platforms should evaluate data services based on both bilateral-use and seller-rejection outcomes, and sellers should distinguish revenue-enhancing from defensive investments. Regulators should distinguish equal-access rules from effective consumer control and monitor pricing in anonymous channels.

</details>


### [219] [Cooperation Without Adaptation: LLM Agents in a Collective-Risk Dilemma](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22882)
*Trung-Kiet Huynh,Dao-Sy Duy-Minh,Chi-Nguyen Tran,Phu-Hoa Pham,Phu-Quy Nguyen-Lam,Le Hong Trang,The Anh Han*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 论文用集体风险困境游戏(CRG)测试五个生产级语言模型智能体是否能根据风险变化与伙伴行为调整贡献策略，发现多数模型采取近乎固定的"公平份额"策略，即便贡献无收益或非最优也照做，说明合作性自博弈不等于策略适应性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型智能体越来越多地代替人在决策相互影响的场景中行动，但尚不清楚它们是随风险与伙伴行为灵活调整策略，还是执行相对固定的策略。仅凭合作性自博弈的表现不足以证明其策略适应性。

Method: 设计十轮六人集体风险困境游戏：玩家向公共池贡献资源，若未达目标则可能发生灾难摧毁剩余资源。让五个生产模型在不同正风险水平、零风险、不同提示语（强调仅自身收益 vs 中性提示）、固定伙伴与混合模型群体等条件下参与，比较其贡献行为与其识别期望收益最优行动的能力，并考察基于收益的选择对群体构成的影响。

Result: 四个模型在所有正风险水平上均贡献约等额份额，五个中有四个在零风险时仍贡献（尽管贡献无法提高收益）。明确说明只关心自身收益能降低多数模型的零风险贡献，中性提示无效。多个模型能正确识别不同风险下期望收益更高的行动，但贡献几乎不变。面对固定伙伴时没有模型能持续选择收益最大化响应；混合模型中单个智能体最后一轮的缺口可致原本成功的群体失败。基于收益的选择依赖群体构成：单一六智能体群体中偏向贡献最少者并降低群体成功率，而在更大随机混合群体中，中高风险下偏向精确公平份额的模型。

Conclusion: 语言模型智能体的合作性表现并不代表策略适应性；多智能体系统评估应像机器行为研究那样，检验智能体对激励、伙伴行动和群体构成的反应。

Abstract: Language-model agents are increasingly deployed to act on behalf of people in settings where individual decisions shape shared outcomes. We examine whether five production models adapt their contributions to changing risks and partner behaviour, or instead follow a relatively fixed strategy. In a collective-risk dilemma game (CRG), six players contribute to a shared pool over ten rounds; if the pool falls short of its target, a catastrophe may destroy their remaining resources. Four models contributed approximately an equal share at every positive risk level, and four of the five also contributed when risk was zero, even though contributing could not improve their payoff. Explicitly stating that only the agent's own payoff mattered reduced zero-risk contributions for most models, while a more neutral prompt did not. Several models correctly identified which action offered the higher expected payoff at different risk levels, yet their contributions changed little. Against fixed partners, no model consistently chose the payoff-maximising response, and in mixed-model groups, a single agent's shortfall in the final round could cause an otherwise successful group to fail. Payoff-based selection also depended on population composition: in a single six-agent group, it favoured the model that contributed least and reduced group success, whereas in larger, randomly mixed populations, it favoured an exact fair-share model at moderate and high risk. These findings show that cooperative self-play alone is not evidence of strategic adaptability. Consistent with a machine-behaviour approach, evaluations of agents in multi-agent systems should test how they respond to incentives, partner actions, and population composition.

</details>


### [220] [On the Convergence of Iterated Round Robin](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23040)
*Maxime Lucet,Henri Surugue,Nawal Benabbou,Aurélie Beynier,Nicolas Maudet,Arianna Novaro*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究迭代版 Round Robin (RR) 分配机制下的最优反应动态：完整信息下刻画了循环与收敛条件（item-preserving swaps 保证收敛），部分信息下分析三种信念更新行为并证明更谨慎规则可使迭代 RR 满足策略防阻性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RR 虽满足 EF1 但可被操纵，已知存在纯 Nash 均衡；作者希望理解智能体反复观察结果并更新报告的动态过程中是否会收敛到均衡，以及在信息不完全时何种行为能避免操纵。

Method: 将 RR 嵌入重复博弈，构建 best-response dynamics；在完全信息设定下分析不同操纵限制（一般操纵、保持物品的交换、相邻交换）下的循环与收敛；在部分信息设定下假设智能体仅观察分配并依据与 RR 序列一致性推断他人偏好，比较三种操纵行为规则。

Result: 完全信息下，即使强限制操纵仍可能出现循环；但 item-preserving swaps 对任意智能体数和物品数均保证收敛到纯 Nash 均衡；相邻交换对两智能体及有限物品数保证收敛，物品数无界情形仍开放。部分信息下，两种自然行为仍可能循环，而更谨慎的规则保证迭代 RR 是策略防阻的。

Conclusion: 迭代 RR 的收敛性高度依赖允许的操纵类型与信息结构；合理限制操纵（item-preserving swaps）可保证均衡收敛，而在不确定性下采用谨慎规则能实现策略防阻，为实际部署迭代式分配机制提供指导。

Abstract: Round Robin (RR) is a simple and widely used picking sequence mechanism for allocating indivisible goods, known to guarantee envy-freeness up to one item (EF1) when preferences are additive. Despite being manipulable (meaning that agents may have an incentive to strategically misreport their preferences), it is known to always admit at least one pure Nash equilibrium. In this paper, we study an iterated variant of RR, in which agents observe the outcome of the mechanism at each iteration and may revise their reported preferences through a best-response dynamics.
  We first consider a full-information setting, where agents observe both the outcome and the reported preferences of all the agents. In this setting, we show that cycles can occur even under strong restrictions on the manipulations carried out by the agents. We nonetheless identify a natural restriction (item-preserving swaps), under which convergence to a pure Nash equilibrium is guaranteed to exist for any number of agents and items. We also show that restricting to adjacent swaps guarantees convergence for two agents and a limited number of items, leaving the question open for unbounded number of items. We then turn to a partial-information setting, in which agents only observe the resulting allocation and must then infer the preference profiles of the others assuming consistency with the RR sequence. We study three behaviours guiding the agents when deciding how to manipulate under uncertainty on the other agents' preferences. We show that two of the studied behaviours, despite being quite natural, may cycle while a more cautious rule guarantees iterated RR to be strategyproof.

</details>


### [221] [Proportionality in Ranking Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23193)
*Daniel Halpern,Xinyu Liu,Evi Micha,Yu Peng Ng,Warut Suksompong*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 该论文研究将给定排序集合压缩为更小规模排序集合的问题，提出三种比例代表概念（位置比例性、成对比例性、稳固联盟比例性PSC），并给出各自的可满足性与算法结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受RLHF（基于人类反馈的强化学习）应用驱动，需要把大量排序数据压缩为少量代表性排序；该问题也可视为排序聚合与多赢家投票两个社会选择框架的结合。

Method: 形式化"排序集合压缩"问题，定义三种比例性概念：位置比例性、成对比例性、稳固联盟比例性（PSC），并分析其可满足性与计算复杂度，同时在单峰与单交叉偏好域下讨论成对比例性。

Result: 位置比例性与PSC对任意输入排序和目标压缩规模总是可满足的，且可在多项式时间内求出所需输出；而成对比例性一般无法满足，但在输入排序为单峰或单交叉时可实现。

Conclusion: 压缩排序集合问题中，位置比例性和PSC具备良好的存在性与可计算性，成对比例性则需依赖结构化偏好域（单峰/单交叉）才能保证；三种概念刻画了不同类型的代表性。

Abstract: Motivated by applications in reinforcement learning from human feedback, we consider a setting where a given collection of rankings needs to be compressed into a smaller collection of rankings. This can also be seen as a combination of two fundamental social choice frameworks: ranking aggregation and multiwinner voting. We propose three proportionality notions that capture different types of representation in this setting: positional proportionality, pairwise proportionality, and proportionality for solid coalitions (PSC). On the one hand, we show that positional proportionality and PSC are always satisfiable for any input rankings and target compression size, and a desired output can be found in polynomial time. On the other hand, we prove that pairwise proportionality cannot be satisfied in general, but can nevertheless be attained when the input rankings are single-peaked or single-crossing.

</details>


### [222] [Trembling toward Duverger: Convergence and Cycles in Synchronous Plurality Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23330)
*Maximilian Weigel,Damien Berriaud,Roger Wattenhofer*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文在固定有限选民群体中构建基于民调与颤抖手最优反应的学习动态模型，证明一次更新通常即可收敛到两强竞争（Duverger定律），但该动态并不总收敛，可能出现周期循环且选民群体越大循环越长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典的pivotal-voter模型依赖大规模选民下的总体投票不确定性来推导Duverger定律，本文希望摆脱这一假设，在固定、有限的选民群体中给出Duverger定律的新微观基础，并刻画该动态学是否收敛。

Method: 提出有限群体模型：民调公布当前支持票数，每个选民在颤抖手信念下（假设其他选民以极小概率偏离）做最优反应。从真实投票出发分析迭代更新动态，证明其收敛条件，并构造反例研究周期循环。

Result: 从真实投票出发，通常一次更新即收敛到所有选民在两位民调领先者中支持其偏好者的稳定状态；任意候选人数下，第二名领先其余候选四票即足够（三候选人时两票足够）；随机偏好下以概率1-O(N^{-1/2})一次更新后出现Duverger定律。但收敛会失败：周期二次循环在稳定画像附近出现少量选民换票；三候选人下可出现周期三次循环（至少需四名选民改变选票），且循环可交替改变多数获胜者；对任意奇数ℓ≥3，真实投票可导致票数每ℓ轮重复、完整投票画像每2ℓ轮重复的循环。

Conclusion: Duverger定律可在有限群体的单次民调更新中稳健涌现，但该动态机制本身并不保证收敛；循环的存在表明均衡选择与稳定性在高维投票环境中较为复杂，且选民规模越大越支持长周期行为。

Abstract: Duverger's law states that plurality elections tend to concentrate support on two candidates. Pivotal-voter models typically derive this from aggregate uncertainty about votes, so that two-candidate competition emerges in the limit of large electorates. We instead propose a model for a fixed, finite population. A poll reveals the current support counts, and each voter best responds under trembling-hand beliefs, assuming that every other voter may deviate with a small probability. Starting from truthful votes, we show that a single update typically suffices for the dynamics to converge to a stable profile in which every voter supports her preferred candidate among the two poll leaders. For any number of candidates and any full-support tremble belief, a four-vote lead of the runner-up over all lower candidates suffices; for three candidates, a lead of two suffices. As a consequence, under random preferences, Duverger's law emerges after one update with probability $1-\mathcal O(N^{-1/2})$.
  While these results may suggest that the dynamics always settle, convergence can fail. Mild period-two cycles already arise, with a few voters swapping ballots around an otherwise stable profile. We show that substantially richer behavior is possible, even with three candidates. Period-three cycles arise with six voters changing their ballots, and no such cycle can involve fewer than four. Cycles can also alternate the plurality winner. Moreover, larger electorates support ever longer cycles: for every odd $\ell\geq3$, truthful voting can lead to a cycle whose vote counts repeat every $\ell$ rounds and whose full ballot profile repeats every $2\ell$ rounds.

</details>


### [223] [Bayesian Learning of Parametric Mean Field Games with Common Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23387)
*Grégoire Lambrecht,Mathieu Laurière*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文提出 BE-MFG 框架，用单个扩展平均场博弈的纳什均衡同时编码所有候选参数的均衡策略，从而在共同噪声下高效地对平均场博弈的未知参数进行贝叶斯反演推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从人群轨迹的部分观测中反推 MFG 的动力学与奖励参数时，似然评估需要为每个候选参数 θ 重新求解一个纳什均衡；共同噪声使平均场演化随机、均衡策略依赖人群分布，导致逐参数求解代价极高。作者希望解决这一计算瓶颈，并厘清参数可辨识性与一致恢复的条件。

Method: 构建 Bayesian-Extended Mean Field Game（BE-MFG）：在参数空间上做扩展，使单一纳什均衡同时给出所有 θ 对应的均衡策略，从而一次性高效计算平均场轨迹的条件密度并用于贝叶斯后验更新。同时形式化定义共同噪声 MFG 下的参数一致性与可辨识性，并给出一致恢复的保证条件。实验上与改造后的 MFG 逆强化学习基线对比，包含三个复杂度不同的合成环境和一组公共电力市场真实数据。

Result: 在三个合成环境中，仅用少量部分、随机的观测即可准确恢复真实参数，性能优于 MFG 逆强化学习适配基线；在公共电力市场数据上的第四个实验表明方法可迁移到真实数据场景。

Conclusion: 通过将参数反演嵌入单一扩展均衡，BE-MFG 大幅降低了共同噪声 MFG 的贝叶斯推断成本，并在理论上给出可辨识与一致性条件，实证上兼具精度与数据效率，具备真实应用潜力。

Abstract: We study the inverse problem of recovering unknown parameters governing the dynamics and rewards of Mean Field Games (MFGs) from partial observations of population trajectories, made stochastic by common noise. The observer seeks to recover a consistent parameter $θ$ via Bayesian inference, facing the challenge that evaluating the likelihood requires solving a new Nash equilibrium (NE) for each candidate $θ$. Due to common noise, the mean-field evolution is stochastic and equilibrium policies are population dependent, which makes solving for each parameter computationally expensive. To overcome this, we introduce the Bayesian-Extended Mean Field Game (BE-MFG), whose single NE simultaneously encodes equilibrium policies for all parameters, enabling efficient learning of the conditional density of mean-field trajectories. We formalize parameter consistency and identifiability in MFGs with common noise and investigate conditions under which consistent parameter recovery is guaranteed. On three synthetic environments of various complexity, we recover the ground-truth parameter accurately from a small number of partial, stochastic observations, outperforming an adaptation of inverse reinforcement learning for MFGs. A fourth experiment, on public electricity market data, suggests that the approach can also be applied to real-world data.

</details>


### [224] [Uniform-Price Mechanism Design for Automated Market Makers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23547)
*Zhike Peng*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究带AMM约束的批量双向拍卖，给出基于数量分桶的随机统一价格机制，在弱数量激励相容下达到Ω(1/(1+logγ)²)V*−O(q̄)的交易量，并证明完全IC会带来O(1/γ)的下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AMM的储备曲线使机制设计不同于经典双向拍卖；用户同时拥有单位价值与数量两维私有信息，需在AMM可行性（储备乘积不减）约束下设计激励相容的统一价格机制以最大化用户侧交易量。

Method: 以最优可行IR统一价格配置的交易量V*为基准；构造基于二元数量分桶的随机统一价格机制，随机选择三种清算模式之一：P2P撮合、AMM向买方出售、卖方向AMM出售。

Result: 机制的每个确定性实现均事后期可行，满足IR与弱数量IC（如实数量下如实报价值为占优策略）。当γ=q̄/q̲≥1时，期望交易量达Ω(1/(1+logγ)²)V*−O(q̄)。同时证明在二维类型空间上完全IC会在任意初始储备比下强制最坏情况近似比为O(1/γ)，即便储备按任意大公因子缩放且V*相对q̄任意大。

Conclusion: AMM约束下统一价格机制可在较弱（数量方向）激励要求下获得接近最优的交易量，而对数量维度的完全激励相容代价高昂；二者之间存在本质权衡。

Abstract: Automated market makers (AMMs) are central to decentralized exchanges, but their reserve curves make mechanism design different from classical double auctions. We study a batch double auction with buyers, sellers, and a liquidity-nondecreasing AMM: post-trade reserves must have weakly larger product than the initial reserves. Each user has two-dimensional private information: a unit value and a demand or supply quantity. User trades clear at one uniform price subject to AMM feasibility. The objective is user-side trading volume, benchmarked against the optimal feasible individually rational (IR) uniform-price allocation. We give a randomized uniform-price mechanism based on binary quantity buckets. It randomly chooses one of three clearing modes: peer-to-peer matching, AMM sales to buyers, and seller sales to the AMM. Every deterministic realization of the mechanism is ex-post feasible and satisfies IR and weak quantity incentive compatibility: conditional on any quantity report, truthful unit-value reporting is dominant whenever it gives a non-negative utility, no unit-value deviation gives a positive utility if the truthful one doesn't, and users cannot benefit by under-reporting the quantity together with their truthful unit value. Let $V^\ast$ be the optimal feasible IR uniform-price volume without incentive constraints, and let $γ=\bar q/\underline q$, where $\bar q$ and $\underline q$ are the quantity-domain bounds. For $γ\ge1$, the mechanism achieves an expected trading volume of $ Ω(1/(1+\logγ)^2)V^\ast - O(\bar q). $ We also show that full incentive compatibility over the two-dimensional type space forces a worst-case approximation ratio of $O(1/γ)$ at every prescribed initial reserve ratio, even when both AMM reserves are scaled by an arbitrarily large common factor and the optimal volume $V^\ast$ is arbitrarily large relative to $\bar q$.

</details>


### [225] [Revisiting the Fairness of Pure Nash Equilibria of Round-Robin](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23686)
*Georgios Amanatidis,Haris Aziz,Georgios Birmpas,Federico Fusco,Stefano Leonardi,Rebecca Reiffenhäuser*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文推翻Amanatidis等(WINE 2021)关于Round-Robin纯Nash均衡均诱导EF1分配的结论，并证明递推平衡选取序列机制的所有纯纳什均衡满足1/2-EF1与PROP1，且2/3-EF1是Round-Robin均衡的紧界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公平分配中Round-Robin机制的均衡福利性质此前有错误断言：Amanatidis等声称加法估值下RR的每个纯纳什均衡都诱导EF1分配。本文旨在纠正该错误，并重新刻画RR及更一般选取序列机制均衡的公平性保证。

Method: 构造反例说明RR纯纳什均衡不保证EF1；对固定递推平衡选取序列机制，用比较两次执行的势函数证明1/2-EF1，用保持代理最有价值物品的偏离论证证明PROP1；并构造一族RR均衡给出2/3-EF1的上界实例。

Result: RR纯纳什均衡不必然EF1（纠正前人结论）；每个固定递推平衡选取序列机制的纯纳什均衡均满足1/2-EF1和PROP1；对RR存在均衡族使得统一保证无法严格优于2/3-EF1。

Conclusion: Round-Robin均衡的公平性保证被高估，正确保证位于1/2与2/3-EF1之间；递推平衡选取序列机制在纯纳什均衡下仍具稳健的近似EF1与PROP1性质。

Abstract: We prove that for additive valuations, not every pure Nash equilibrium of the Round-Robin mechanism induces an allocation that is envy-free up to one good (EF1) with respect to the agents' true valuations. This corrects an earlier claim of Amanatidis et al. (WINE 2021; Math. Oper. Res. 2024). On the positive side, every pure Nash equilibrium of every fixed recursively balanced picking sequence mechanism induces an allocation that is $1/2$-EF1 and proportional up to one good (PROP1). We prove the approximate EF1 guarantee through a potential function comparing two executions, and the proportionality guarantee via a deviation that preserves the agent's most valuable goods. We also give a family of Round Robin equilibria showing that it is not possible to have a strictly better guarantee than $2/3$-EF1 for all equilibria.

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

# cs.IR [[Back]](#toc)

### [226] [NoveltyScope: A Multi-Agent Research Assistant for Evidence-Grounded Novelty Assessment of Scientific Papers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22703)
*Yueran Tian,Huizhi Liang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: NoveltyScope是一个原型系统，通过检索先验工作、抽取贡献、生成配对反驳证据并进行多智能体打分，对科学论文进行有依据的新颖性评估（五级评分）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有新颖性评估多依赖LLM直接判断，缺乏可追溯的证据支撑，容易产生无根据的评分。作者希望实现"证据驱动"的新颖性评估。

Method: 抽取论文核心任务与至多两项作者声称的贡献；在封闭本地语料上用BM25+稠密检索并以RRF融合；对贡献比较请求配对段落以寻找潜在反驳，引文与缓存原文核验；由Prosecutor、Defender、Judge、Critic四种角色基于证据打分，Judge最多修订一次。

Result: 在50个类平衡RINoBench样本上，Gemini下单LLM与多智能体MAE分别为1.48与1.26，Qwen3下为1.22与1.16；向量相似度基线为1.68。HiCLIP案例展示了贡献比较与配对证据。

Conclusion: 结果证明证据驱动的新颖性评估可行，且两类模型上多智能体配置的评分误差均低于单LLM基线。

Abstract: NoveltyScope is a prototype that compares a scientific paper with retrieved prior work and produces a structured report and a five-level novelty score. The system extracts the core task and at most two author-claimed contributions, then searches a closed local corpus using BM25 and dense retrieval with reciprocal rank fusion. Contribution comparisons request paired passages for potential refutations, and quotations are checked against cached source text. Four scoring roles (Prosecutor, Defender, Judge, and Critic) use the resulting evidence, with at most one revision of the Judge's score. Evaluation uses 50 class-balanced RINoBench samples whose idea-level labels are retained for full-paper input. Mean absolute error is 1.48 and 1.26 for single-LLM and multi-agent scoring with Gemini, respectively, and 1.22 and 1.16 with Qwen3. The vector-similarity baseline has an error of 1.68. A HiCLIP case study illustrates the contribution comparisons and paired evidence passages. Overall, the results demonstrate the feasibility of evidence-grounded novelty assessment and show that the multi-agent configurations achieve lower scoring errors than their single-LLM counterparts across both evaluated models.

</details>


### [227] [Reasoning Reranking with Semantic IDs as the Sole Item Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22797)
*Zhenwei Tang,Jintao Liu,Di Bai,Xidong Wu,Xinwu Cheng*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文构建 ReRankID 试验台检验仅用 Semantic ID 让推理式重排器对候选集排序是否可行，发现现成模型倾向于照抄输入顺序，而 SFT、拒绝采样自训练、on-policy 蒸馏与基于验证器的强化学习等后训练方法可激发该能力，最强 8B 模型（分级排序奖励）达到约 20 倍长文本提示的强 LLM 水平，但物品描述忠实性仍不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理重排器依赖物品元数据文本，而生成式推荐器日益用紧凑 Semantic ID 表示物品；SID 提示更短，且其 token 嵌入部分由用户-物品交互序列学习，隐含行为信号。但 SID 训练目标是下一物品生成，能否仅凭 SID 对给定候选集排序尚未被验证。

Method: 构建 ReRankID 受控测试台：模型仅基于 SID 表示的历史与候选集进行推理和排序，逐一改变物品呈现方式、历史长度与候选集大小。对比 SFT、拒绝采样自训练、on-policy 蒸馏、基于验证器的强化学习四种后训练方法，并进行配对理由审计。

Result: 基线模型常复制输入顺序而非真正重排，可读元数据也无法修复。各后训练方法均能激发排序行为；最强的 8B 分级排序奖励模型取得最佳 SID-only 排序效果，与提示长约 20 倍的强文本 LLM 相当；无历史时仍优于随机（标题阅读基线则不能），长历史下（文本提示超 50k token）仍保持增益。理由审计中该模型权衡论证优于标题基线，但物品描述准确性较差。

Conclusion: 常见后训练方法能激发从 SID 排序的能力，但不能带来忠实的物品描述，说明未来需要改进推理本身而非仅改进排序输出的后训练方案。

Abstract: Reasoning rerankers write a rationale before ranking a candidate slate, and existing systems read item metadata to do so, even though generative recommenders increasingly represent items as compact Semantic IDs (SIDs). Ranking from SIDs alone has two appeals: SID prompts are far shorter than the matched item text, and although item codes are fixed from content, the backbone learns their token embeddings in part from user-item interaction sequences, so the tokens can carry behavioral signal that item text lacks. That training targets next-item generation, and whether it supports ranking a supplied slate from SIDs alone is untested. We build ReRankID, a controlled testbed in which models reason and rank from a history and slate shown only as SIDs, varying item rendering, history length, and slate size one at a time. On this testbed, such models often copy the input order instead of reranking, and readable metadata does not repair the failure. We compare supervised fine-tuning, rejection-sampled self-training, on-policy distillation, and verifier-based reinforcement learning as post-training methods and find that they elicit the missing behavior. The strongest post-trained model, the 8B model trained with a graded ranking reward, gives the best SID-only ranking and matches strong text-reading LLMs whose prompts are about 20x longer. It ranks above random with no history at all, where a caption-reading reference does not, and it keeps its gains at long histories, where text prompts pass 50k tokens and the caption-reading reference stops improving. In a paired rationale audit, this model argues trade-offs better than that reference but describes items less accurately. The common post-training methods we test thus elicit ranking from SIDs but not faithful item descriptions, which calls for post-training that improves the reasoning itself, not only the ranking it produces.

</details>


### [228] [Jev-as-a-Judge for Brazilian Portuguese Information Retrieval: Relevance Assessment and Reranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23346)
*Leandro Carísio Fernandes,Jayr Pereira*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本研究评估 System One 模型 Jev 在信息检索中的应用：作为相关性判定器为四个巴西葡萄牙语 IR 数据集生成相关性标注，并作为重排器。结果显示其与人工标注总体一致性良好，系统排名基本不变，且重排显著提升 nDCG@10 与 MRR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究轻量、快速的 System One 模型 Jev 能否在信息检索中替代或辅助人工相关性判定及排序，尤其在巴西葡萄牙语场景下验证其可行性与效果。

Method: 以 Jev-as-a-judge 为四个不同领域的巴西葡萄牙语 IR 数据集生成相关性判定，与官方 qrels 对比（精确一致率、二次加权 Cohen's kappa、Kendall's tau 系统排名一致性）；并将 Jev 作为重排器，对 50 条 Quati 测试查询的 BM25 top-1000 候选重排。

Result: 相关性判定精确一致率 52.9%–64.9%，kappa 0.52–0.82；≥94.5% 标注相同或仅差一个等级；NormasTCU 与 Ulysses-RFCorpus 系统排名 Kendall's tau 达 0.90–0.93。重排使 nDCG@10 由 0.3329 升至 0.6331（+90.2%），MRR 由 0.6852 升至 0.9033（+31.8%）。

Conclusion: Jev 可作为有效的相关性判定器，虽在个体查询-文档层面存在差异但系统排名保持一致；作为重排器在评测设置下显著优于 BM25，支持其检索应用价值。

Abstract: This study investigates Jev, a System One model designed for fast, structured decision-making, in information retrieval. We use Jev-as-a-judge to generate relevance judgments for four Brazilian Portuguese IR collections covering different domains and compare them with the official relevance judgments of each collection. We also evaluate Jev as a reranker. For relevance assessment, exact agreement ranged from 52.9% to 64.9%, while quadratic weighted Cohen's kappa ranged from 0.52 to 0.82. Most disagreements involved adjacent relevance levels, with at least 94.5% of annotations matching exactly or differing by only one relevance level. Despite differences at the individual query--document level, Jev-generated qrels produced similar retrieval system rankings, with Kendall's tau ranging from 0.90 to 0.93 for NormasTCU and Ulysses-RFCorpus across the two evaluation metrics. For reranking, Jev reordered the top 1,000 BM25 candidates for each of the 50 Quati test queries, increasing nDCG@10 from 0.3329 to 0.6331 (+90.2%) and MRR from 0.6852 to 0.9033 (+31.8%). These findings support Jev as a relevance assessor and show improved ranking effectiveness over BM25 in the evaluated reranking setting.

</details>


### [229] [QD-Rec: Open-Ended Evolution of Recommendations via Quality-Diversity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23470)
*Takashi Ishida,Taro Makino,Issa Sugiura*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出QD-Rec，一种质量-多样性方法，将开放式搜索与基础模型结合用于决策推荐：用上下文bandit选择物品，用基础模型基于存档中的先前假设生成新假设，从而构建多样且高质量的推荐集合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高风险决策（如收购哪家公司、瞄准哪个客户）中，比较多个有充分理由的选项比单一排序列表更有用；现有推荐通常只给排序列表，缺少"为什么适合"的多样化理由，而开放式搜索已在算法、数学问题等方面展现潜力，故将其扩展到决策推荐。

Method: 形式化开放式推荐为构建多样化高质量推荐集合，每条推荐由物品加一个自然语言假设（选择理由）组成。提出QD-Rec：用上下文bandit选择物品，用基础模型基于存档中保存的先前假设作为"踏脚石"生成新假设；若新推荐新颖或优于其最近邻则进入存档。

Result: 在并购、客户定向、论文与图书推荐四类任务上，QD-Rec在多数设置下取得最高平均质量并构建最大存档。

Conclusion: 将开放式搜索范式与质量-多样性机制结合可有效支持开放式决策推荐，生成多样且有推理依据的推荐集合。

Abstract: Open-ended search combined with foundation models has produced advances such as faster algorithms, new results on open mathematical problems, and self-improving agents. We extend this paradigm to recommendation for decision-making, focusing on decisions where the set of possible choices is fixed but the reasons for choosing them are not. In high-stakes decisions, e.g., which company to acquire or which customer to target, comparing diverse, well-reasoned options can be more useful than a single ranked list. We formalize open-ended recommendation as building a diverse, high-quality set of recommendations, each an item together with a hypothesis, a natural-language reason why the item fits the needs of a decision maker. We propose QD-Rec, a quality--diversity method that selects items with a contextual bandit and generates hypotheses with a foundation model from earlier ones kept in an archive as stepping stones. A new recommendation enters the archive if it is novel or better than its nearest neighbor. Across M&A, customer targeting, and paper and book recommendation, QD-Rec gives the highest mean quality and builds the largest archive in most settings.

</details>


### [230] [LSNR: Learned Sparse News Recommendations with Attentive User Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23510)
*David Vos,Andrew Yates,Maarten de Rijke*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出LSNR，独立编码每篇新闻并用注意力加权聚合+用户级稠密投影扩展构造稀疏用户向量，解决STAR式拼接造成的兴趣塌缩与上下文超限问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学习稀疏推荐方法（如STAR）把用户历史拼接成单一查询串。对新闻而言有两大瓶颈：(1) 拼接把用户多种阅读兴趣压平成单一查询；(2) 新闻是长文本，多篇拼接很快超出骨干语言模型上下文窗口，被迫截断导致质量下降。

Method: LSNR 对每篇文章独立编码，得到逐篇稀疏表示；再通过学习到的注意力机制对这些表示加权组合，并在用户层面做稠密投影扩展，从而构造稀疏用户向量。

Result: 在MIND和EBNeRD上显著优于STAR，且在短历史（不受截断影响）场景下增益依然存在；与SOTA稠密推荐器相比，标准设置下具竞争力，短历史时更优。用户编码器消融表明注意力聚合优于简单池化。索引规模比未压缩稠密基线小一个数量级。

Conclusion: 独立编码+注意力聚合+稠密扩展的稀疏用户建模能同时缓解兴趣塌缩与上下文限制，兼顾效果、短历史鲁棒性与存储效率。

Abstract: Current learned sparse approaches for recommender systems, such as STAR, represent a user by concatenating their interaction history into a single query string. For news, this creates two bottlenecks: concatenation collapses a user's distinct reading interests into one flat query, and, because news articles are long-form text, concatenating several news articles quickly overruns the context window of the language model used as backbone and forces quality-degrading truncation.
  To address both bottlenecks, we introduce learned sparse news recommendations (LSNR). LSNR encodes each article independently and constructs a sparse user vector by combining learned, attention-based weighting of the per-article sparse representations with a dense-projected expansion at the user level. Experiments on the MIND and EBNeRD datasets show that LSNR significantly outperforms STAR, with these gains holding even in short-history settings where truncation is not a factor. Compared to state-of-the-art dense recommenders, LSNR is competitive in standard settings and it outperforms them when the user history is short. An ablation of the user encoder confirms that learned attention-based aggregation outperforms simpler pooling alternatives. Beyond effectiveness, an additional advantage of LSNR is that it serves from an index an order of magnitude smaller than an uncompressed dense baseline.

</details>


### [231] [Humanity's Last Choice: A Common Evaluation Standard for Generative Engine Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23541)
*Qianfeng Wen,Yifan Simon Liu,Difan Jiao,Junda Wu,Di Bai,Jintao Liu,Xidong Wu,Zhenwei Tang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出"人类最后的选择"问题——即在GEO环境下比较不同AI系统的可靠性,指出现有基准因自定义GEO策略空间与编辑约束差异导致结果不可比,呼吁建立统一评测标准并给出元分类学。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成引擎优化(GEO)让内容提供者可编辑被AI引用的外部来源以提升可见性与推荐影响力。用户在选择信赖哪个AI系统时需要可比较的证据,但现有基准各自定义GEO策略空间、采用不同编辑约束,使"算法更优"带来的增益与"编辑自由度更大"带来的增益相混淆,跨基准覆盖率难以比较。

Method: 提出统一的评测标准,并构建一个元分类学(meta-taxonomy),从三方面刻画GEO策略:来源在何处被编辑、如何被编辑、编辑针对何种信号。基于代表性文献将现有策略映射为可检索的策略空间,并给出带显式覆盖率报告的受控比较协议。

Result: 现有GEO策略被系统性地组织进一个可搜索的统一空间;所提出的协议可在控制编辑约束的前提下进行比较,并明确报告评测覆盖范围,从而区分算法优劣与编辑自由度带来的差异。

Conclusion: 统一评测标准与元分类学为跨基准的公共排行榜奠定基础,帮助人们判断应当依赖哪些AI系统。

Abstract: Humanity's Last Choice describes the idea that the last choice people need to make is which AI system they entrust with the decisions that follow. These systems rely on external sources that content providers can edit through generative engine optimization (GEO) to increase source visibility and influence recommendations. Choosing among these systems therefore requires comparable evidence of how well they carry out user requests when exposed to GEO. Benchmarks have made progress in standardizing tasks, models, and metrics, but they often define their own spaces of GEO strategies and use different editing constraints. These differences can conflate gains from better optimization algorithms with those from greater freedom to edit sources, while making evaluation coverage difficult to compare across benchmarks. We therefore call for a common evaluation standard and propose a meta-taxonomy that describes where sources are edited, how they are edited, and what signals those edits target. Drawing on representative literature, we map existing strategies into a searchable space and outline a protocol for controlled comparisons with explicit coverage reporting. This provides a foundation for common leaderboards that can inform which systems people choose to rely on.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [232] [When is a large language model a good calibration agent? Physics-labeled prompting for budgeted engineering simulator calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22379)
*Ruo-Qian Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在昂贵仿真器校准中，以物理诊断描述为条件的LLM能否比传统无导数优化器更高效地提出参数更新，并提出LLM热启动+传统优化器的两阶段混合工作流。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 昂贵工程仿真器的参数校准受计算成本严重制约，需要更高效地利用有限评估预算来生成有信息量的参数更新。

Method: 在圆柱尾流大涡模拟和阻尼振子逆问题上测试：对比物理标注提示与四种文本消融（移除、匿名、填充、误导）及标准优化器（Nelder-Mead、贝叶斯优化、CMA-ES、随机搜索）；并提出用LLM作热启动、将累积评估交给传统优化器的两阶段数值延拓策略。

Result: 首次物理信息LLM提案在25次试验中23次改善初始设计；5次评估后中位校正误差比无物理控制低21.9倍，但优势到15次评估时消失，且解码器固有变异性造成9.8倍性能差异。混合工作流仅需9次仿真即达目标准确率，优于纯LLM（12次）、Nelder-Mead（17次）和贝叶斯优化（>60次）。

Conclusion: 物理标注的LLM在严格评估预算下可作为有效的校准智能体，但其单独优势短暂且不稳定，通过与传统优化器结合的两阶段混合方案可显著提升效率并稳健达标。

Abstract: Calibrating expensive engineering simulators requires tuning model parameters to match reference data, a process heavily constrained by computational costs. This study investigates whether Large Language Models (LLMs), conditioned on physical diagnostic descriptions of simulation errors, can propose informative parameter updates more efficiently than conventional derivative-free optimizers. We test this on a cylinder-wake Large-Eddy Simulation and a damped-oscillator inverse problem. Physics-labeled prompts are evaluated against four text ablations (removed, anonymized, padded, misdirected) and standard optimizers (Nelder-Mead, Bayesian optimization, CMA-ES, and random search). Results demonstrate a strong early semantic advantage: the first physics-informed LLM proposal improves the initial design in 23 of 25 trials. After five evaluations, the median calibration error is 21.9 times lower than physics-free controls. However, this advantage is transient - disappearing by fifteen evaluations - and inherent LLM decoder variability yields a 9.8-fold performance spread. To address this, we introduce a hybrid workflow that uses the LLM as a warm-start, passing accumulated evaluations to a conventional optimizer. This two-stage numerical continuation policy reaches target accuracy in just 9 simulator runs, outperforming the LLM alone (12 runs), Nelder-Mead (17 runs), and Bayesian optimization (>60 runs). Supported by sensitivity analysis validating the test cases, this hybrid physics-labeled LLM scheme proves highly effective as a calibration agent under strict evaluation budgets.

</details>


### [233] [Trust but Verify: Designing Region-Inhomogeneous Forward Dynamics for Discrete Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22380)
*Gunmay Jhingran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MASQUERADE? 不，本文提出将吸收核与均匀混合核、区域差异化速率结合的连续-离散混合前向过程，让模型在训练中接触"已观测但不可信"的上下文，并配以推理时的启发式噪声重注入采样器，低成本提升掩码扩散模型对上下文腐坏的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散语言扩散普遍采用吸收式腐坏，生成过程中始终完全信任上下文，形成"二元信任"：被腐坏的上下文会被当作真值复制，错误向生成片段传播。作者希望重新打开前向过程的设计空间，引入"中间信任"状态。

Method: 1) 前向过程：缺失位采用吸收动力学，上下文采用低速率均匀随机替换，形成区域依赖的混合核；2) 推理：启发式采样器对可疑上下文按退火强度重注入噪声，并在轨迹后期冻结上下文更新；3) 在预训练170M掩码扩散模型上做8000步微调（6GB笔记本GPU，<5小时）。

Result: 基模型对均匀随机垃圾上下文仍赋约50%概率给观测token。微调后：均匀随机腐坏检测recall 0.96、precision 0.91；10%/20%腐坏下infill token-F1提升3.8/6.4点，并消除腐坏邻域的精度下降；干净条件下无显著回退，误编辑率<0.4%。对"貌似合理"腐坏增益较弱（10%时约0.5 F1点，不显著）。

Conclusion: 可检测性与危害共同取决于偏离数据条件的程度：近邻噪声难检测且语义温和，远距噪声显著却破坏性强。作者将吸收扩散视为"信任轴"的无限对比度极限，类比扩散修复中已知/未知区域的信噪比差距；在170M单域设定下，通过改变前向动力学而非架构即实现中间信任。

Abstract: Continuous diffusion treats the forward process as a design space; discrete language diffusion often uses absorbing corruption, leaving context fully trusted throughout generation. This makes trust binary: corrupted context is copied as ground truth, propagating errors into generated spans. We reopen this design space by combining absorbing and uniform-mixing kernels with region-dependent rates. Missing positions follow absorbing dynamics, while context undergoes low-rate random substitution, exposing the model to observed but uncertain tokens during training. At inference, a heuristic sampler re-injects noise into suspicious context under an annealed intensity and freezes context updates late in the trajectory. An 8,000-step finetune of a pretrained 170M-parameter masked diffusion model takes under five hours on a 6 GB laptop GPU. The base model assigns roughly 50% probability to observed tokens even when they are uniform-random garbage. For uniform-random corruption, finetuning detects corrupted context with 0.96 recall and 0.91 precision, improves infill token-F1 by 3.8 points at 10% corruption and 6.4 points at 20%, and removes the accuracy dip next to corruptions. Clean conditioning shows no measurable regression, with a false-edit rate below 0.4%. Gains for plausible corruptions are weaker: about 0.5 F1 points at 10% corruption, without statistical significance. Our results suggest that detectability and damage depend jointly on departure from the data conditional: nearby noise is hard to detect and semantically mild, while distant noise is conspicuous and destructive. We interpret absorbing diffusion as the infinite-contrast limit of a trust axis, analogous to the signal-to-noise gap between known and unknown regions in diffusion inpainting. In our setting of a 170M model and a single text domain, intermediate trust is reached by changing forward dynamics rather than architecture.

</details>


### [234] [Binding-Specific Relearning Savings for Test-Time Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22381)
*Zhe Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出"重学节省"（relearning savings）评估范式，检验在参数更新的时序学习中，曾经学过的特定事实绑定是否在后续遗忘后带来超出一般暴露的重学优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的测试时持续学习智能体通常只用当前输出准确率来评价，这会掩盖此前经验对后续参数更新的影响；当模型难以输出某事实时，无法区分是"遗忘"还是"暂时难以访问"。

Method: 在 Qwen2.5-1.5B 上设置三种匹配且平衡的历史条件：LEARNED（真实绑定）、CONTROL（无该绑定的等量暴露）、WRONG（同一槽位上的竞争性但关系合法的答案），随后施加相同的无复述持续微调流，在预设的部分遗忘检查点上比较重学速度，并控制实体、词汇、格式、查询槽位等熟悉度因素及重学前行为差异。

Result: LEARNED 比 CONTROL 更快重新获得目标事实；WRONG 相对 CONTROL 无正向优势（其与 LEARNED 的比较提供槽位匹配的佐证，但可能受竞争干扰）；在调整重学前行为后优势仍成立。基于未配对从未见过词池的次级描述性换算显示，先前学习使恢复所需优化器更新减少约 18%。

Conclusion: 当前行为准确率会低估先前已获得经验的持久影响；需要用时序性、遗忘—重学的测量方式来评估持续学习智能体。

Abstract: When a fact becomes harder to elicit from a language model, has the model lost it, or has it merely become less accessible? Parameter-updating test-time continual learning agents are usually evaluated by current output accuracy; we ask whether that measurement captures how prior experience shapes later updates. We test whether learning a specific factual binding produces a later relearning advantage beyond familiarity with its entity, answer vocabulary, format, or query slot. In Qwen2.5-1.5B, we compare three matched, counterbalanced histories: LEARNED receives the correct binding, CONTROL receives matched exposure without it, and WRONG receives a competing relation-valid answer in the same slot. After an identical rehearsal-free continual fine-tuning stream, LEARNED reacquires the target faster than CONTROL at a prespecified checkpoint of partial forgetting. WRONG shows no positive advantage over CONTROL, while its comparison with LEARNED provides slot-matched corroboration, subject to possible competitor interference. The advantage remains positive after adjustment for measured pre-relearning behavior. In a secondary descriptive conversion using an unpaired never-seen pool, prior learning reduces the optimizer updates required for restoration by about 18%. Current behavioral accuracy can therefore underestimate the lasting effect of previously acquired experience. Code is available at https://github.com/zhezhou1106/relearning-savings

</details>


### [235] [CGDT-CESN: Correlation-Guided and Dynamics-Trained Clustered Echo State Network for Multivariate Time-Series Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22430)
*Hariharan Srinivasan,Masoom Bhargava,Sayan Gupta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出相关性引导且动力学训练的聚类回声状态网络(CGDT-CESN)，用变量间相关性构建并训练簇间连接，实现多元时间序列预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多元时间序列预测需同时捕捉变量自身动力学与跨变量交互，传统ESN难以刻画时变跨变量依赖。

Method: 模块化储备池，每个簇专精一个变量；簇间连接由经验观测的变量相关性初始化，并在读出不训练之外额外训练簇间连接权重，形成数据驱动耦合。

Result: 在Twitter信息级联演化与太阳风预测两个差异显著的数据集上优于传统ESN；多预测步长及低数据量下提升仍保持。

Conclusion: 将簇级专精与可学习的变量耦合统一，为多元时间序列预测提供有原则的数据驱动途径，且计算高效。

Abstract: Accurate prediction of multivariate time series requires models that simultaneously capture variable-specific dynamics and cross-variable interactions. In this work, a Correlation-Guided and Dynamics-Trained Clustered Echo State Network (CGDT-CESN) is proposed, which comprises a modular reservoir architecture with each cluster distinctly specializing in one of the variables in the multivariate time series. An innovative reservoir design is proposed in which inter-cluster connections are enabled by empirically observed correlations among variables, providing a data-driven coupling mechanism. Apart from conventional readout training, inter-cluster connection weights informed by correlations are trained, which in turn allows the reservoir to capture time-varying cross-variable dependencies without sacrificing computational efficiency and further improves forecasting accuracy. The prediction performance of CGDT-CESN is found to be superior to that of the conventional ESN when evaluated on two fundamentally different datasets: Twitter information cascade evolution and solar wind forecasting. Also, the improvement in performance is preserved across multiple prediction horizons, even when presented with a low volume of data. By unifying cluster-specific specialization with learned inter-variable coupling, CGDT-CESN offers a principled, data-driven route to multivariate time series prediction.

</details>


### [236] [BOLT: Multi-Bottleneck Bound-Guided Learning for Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling with Time Lags and Resource-Coupled Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22433)
*Ziheng Zhang,Wei Zhang,Yunyi Zhao,Zuming Liu,Wei Zhou,Boon Ping Gan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BOLT提出面向车辆运输耦合的柔性作业车间调度方法，用链、机器产能与车队产能松弛构造下界，并把下界每步增量作为可证明的奖励信号指导策略，在预制构件生产实例中显著优于调度规则与CP求解器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当稀缺车队在工作站间运输工件时，柔性作业车间调度与运输相互耦合：调度本身决定了运输等待时间，而传统做法（如运输惩罚）无法显式刻画这一耦合，导致调度质量不佳。

Method: 构建由链松弛、机器产能松弛和车队产能松弛组合的下界；该下界等于终止时的makespan，因此其逐步增量构成"常数减makespan"的奖励；由于下界不超过可达makespan，每次界提升即是对makespan下界的可证明抬升，策略将其视为价格信号；根节点界可在无求解器情况下证明完成调度的次优性间隙。

Result: 在10模块预制构件实例上，当载货移动占车队时间≥66%时显式运输耦合在所有测试单元均优于运输惩罚策略，≤56%时则均不占优；五个零样本50/80模块批次中，BOLT在四个上优于最佳调度规则对，在三个长距离移动场景上优于惩罚策略；三车80模块批次均值makespan比最佳规则对低13.0%，比一小时预算CP求解器低4.2%（后者平均证明间隙34%）；单核每事件决策2.3–5.9 ms，扰动后可秒级重规划。

Conclusion: 显式建模运输耦合并以可证下界作为学习信号，能在高载货占比场景中带来实质调度改进，兼具认证次优性间隙与实时性，适用于预制构件等实际生产场景。

Abstract: Flexible job-shop scheduling becomes resource-coupled when a scarce vehicle fleet moves jobs between stations, because the schedule sets the transport waits. BOLT (bound-oriented learning for transport-coupled scheduling) builds a lower bound from chain, machine-capacity, and fleet-capacity relaxations. The bound equals the makespan at termination, so its per-step changes form a reward that sums to a constant minus the makespan. Because it never exceeds the attainable makespan, each candidate's bound increase is a proven rise of the makespan floor, which the policy reads as a price. The root bound certifies a completed schedule's suboptimality gap without a solver. On industry-motivated 10-module prefabricated-construction instances, explicit transport coupling outperforms a transport-penalty policy in every tested cell where loaded moves occupy at least 66% of fleet time and in none at or below 56%. Across five zero-shot 50- and 80-module production batches, BOLT outperforms the best dispatching-rule pair on four and the penalty policy on the three with long moves. In the three-vehicle 80-module batch, its mean makespan is 13.0% below the best pair and 4.2% below an hour-budget constraint-programming solver whose proven gap averages 34%. BOLT decides in 2.3-5.9 ms per event on one processor core and re-plans a disruption in seconds.

</details>


### [237] [TRACE: Transformer Residual Activation Codebook Encoding for Communication-efficient Distributed Edge Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22435)
*Muhammad Azlan Qazi,Alexandros Iosifidis,Qi Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Trace 在每层 Transformer 的注意力后残差处放置向量量化器，预计算码本索引对应的 K/V，使接收端通过查表直接获得 K/V，消除通信后的下游计算，实现通信-计算重叠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式 Transformer 推理在边缘设备间序列并行时受通信带宽限制，激活交换主导延迟；现有压缩方案虽降成本，但接收数据仍需做 K/V 投影后才能注意力，计算被串行化在通信之后。

Method: 在后注意力残差处放 VQ 并预计算码本索引到 K/V 的映射；推理时只传码本索引，接收端查表恢复 K/V。层级聚类把码本组织成多分辨率层次，支持不重训即可运行时调节码率；提供精度优先与精度-效率平衡（缓冲兼容量化）两种变体。

Result: ViT-Base（ImageNet-1K、CIFAR-100）与 ViViT-B（UCF-101）上，比 SOTA VQ 分布式推理框架最高提升 1.89% 准确率、1.27x 端到端加速；相比未压缩序列并行推理，通信开销最多降低 22,624x。

Conclusion: 通过将 K/V 计算前移到发送端并以码本查表替代，Trace 打破了压缩后仍需下游计算的串行瓶颈，兼顾精度、效率与可调码率。

Abstract: Distributed Transformer inference across co-located edge devices is fundamentally communication-bound, as exchanging activations between sequence-parallel partitions dominates inference latency under commodity edge bandwidths. Existing compression schemes reduce this cost but retain a structural bottleneck: the received data must still undergo key/value projection before attention can proceed, serializing computation behind communication. This paper presents Transformer Residual Activation Codebook Encoding (Trace), a framework that addresses these limitations. Trace places a Vector Quantizer (VQ) at the post-attention residual of every Transformer layer and precomputes codebook-indexed key/value representations. During inference, exchanged activations are encoded into compact codebook indices, allowing receivers to directly recover keys and values through table lookup instead of executing the downstream computations required to derive them. By eliminating the received data downstream computation, Trace enables communication--computation overlap and reduces a key latency bottleneck in distributed Transformer inference. A hierarchical clustering further structures the learned codebook into a multi-resolution hierarchy, enabling runtime adaptation of the communication bitrate without retraining. The framework supports two operating variants: one prioritizing accuracy and the other balancing accuracy and efficiency through buffer-compatible quantization. Experiments on ViT-Base (ImageNet-1K and CIFAR-100) and ViViT-B (UCF-101) show that Trace achieves up to 1.89% higher accuracy and up to 1.27x end-to-end inference speedup compared with the state-of-the-art VQ-based distributed inference framework. Compared with uncompressed sequence-parallel inference, Trace reduces communication overhead by up to 22,624x.

</details>


### [238] [Generative adversarial networks with Monte Carlo dropout uncertainty quantification for structural health monitoring: Fibre Bragg grating data augmentation comparison in Hawk T1A aircraft](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22436)
*Alvaro Peiro,Marios Impraimakis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个结合条件GAN与MC Dropout不确定性量化的数据增强框架，学习航空结构响应的类别条件时频特征，生成随机合成信号，并通过多域对比与分类评估验证其物理真实性与可用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全关键航空结构健康监测中，监督式损伤分类常面临实测数据稀缺或类别不平衡问题，需要可信的合成数据来增强数据集，同时合成信号必须具备物理真实性和可靠的不确定性度量。

Method: 构建条件生成对抗网络学习类别条件的时间与频谱特征，并结合蒙特卡洛Dropout作为贝叶斯近似进行不确定性量化，实现随机信号合成；随后在时间、频率、不确定性、变异性和特征域将生成响应与实测数据比较；最后评估合成数据是否应纳入监督式损伤分类流程。在BAE Systems Hawk T1A全尺寸基准数据集上验证，涵盖加速度、光纤布拉格光栅应变及非线性动态响应测量。

Result: 模型能准确捕捉主导结构动力学；基于不确定性特征可指导信号如何用于提升分类；生成的不确定性估计与信号复杂度和激励特性相关联，具有实际意义。

Conclusion: 该框架为数据驱动的结构健康监测提供了切实可行的生成式建模方案，可作为稳健的数字孪生组件，支持安全关键航空系统状态评估中的韧性决策。

Abstract: The signal generation capabilities of a novel data augmentation framework are examined in aerospace structures. First, the framework learns class-conditional temporal and spectral characteristics of the measured structural responses. It uses conditional generative adversarial network training and Monte Carlo dropout uncertainty quantification as a Bayesian approximation. This step enables stochastic signal synthesis and uncertainty quantification. Second, the generated responses are rigorously compared against experimental measurements across time, frequency, uncertainty, variability, and feature domains to assess physical realism, statistical consistency, and distributional fidelity. Finally, the synthetic data are evaluated to determine whether they should be incorporated into a supervised damage classification workflow. The framework is validated on the full-scale benchmark dataset from a BAE Systems Hawk T1A aircraft tested at the University of Sheffield's Structural Dynamics Laboratory for Verification and Validation. The test involves acceleration, fibre Bragg grating strain, and nonlinear dynamic response measurements. The results demonstrate that the model accurately captures dominant structural dynamics, it guides on signal use for classification improvement based on uncertainty characteristics, and it provides meaningful uncertainty estimates linked to signal complexity and excitation characteristics. Importantly, the framework offers a realistic generative modelling plan as a robust digital twin component for data-driven structural health monitoring, supporting resilient decision-making for condition assessment in safety-critical aerospace systems.

</details>


### [239] [CF-NODE: Counterfactual Spatial Node Intervention for Test-Time Adaptation Under Domain Shift, Evaluated Across Five Diabetic Retinopathy Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22437)
*Sabarish G,Deepak Parashar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CF-NODE，一种反事实测试时自适应框架，用于跨域糖尿病视网膜病变分级。它不依赖预测置信度或目标分布估计，而是通过受控扰动内部空间节点、观察预测响应的稳定性来对分级分布做有界校准，实现单张图像独立自适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于眼底图像的自动化DR分级可扩大筛查能力，但源域训练的模型在不同相机、诊所和人群间性能急剧下降。现有测试时自适应方法依赖熵最小化或批次/流式累积的目标信息，易强化"自信但错误"的预测，且难以应对临床中独立到达的单张图像。

Method: CF-NODE以"对支撑证据施加受控干预后预测如何响应"为核心：利用模型派生注意力、特征幅值和节点集相似度对内部空间节点排序，逐步衰减最高排名节点，并根据期望分级响应的稳定性对预测分级分布施加有界校准。框架完全冻结，仅用几何视图和固定源域先验，逐图独立自适应，无需目标域信息或模型更新。

Result: 在五个外部DR数据集上重复随机种子评估，与TENT、EATA、SAR、T3A对比，CF-NODE优于全部四种方法，相对第二名提升具统计显著性；在每个目标域上均提升AUC，取得最高平均AUC和宏F1，在各级DR严重程度上识别更均衡。

Conclusion: 反事实干预敏感性为单张图像临床推理提供了稳定、可直接部署的域鲁棒性。

Abstract: Automated fundus-based diabetic retinopathy (DR) grading can substantially expand screening capacity, but source-trained models degrade sharply across different cameras, clinics, and patient populations. Existing test-time adaptation methods depend on entropy minimization or target information accumulated from image batches and streams. These mechanisms can reinforce confidently incorrect predictions and break down when clinical images arrive independently. We introduce CF-NODE, a novel counterfactual test-time adaptation framework for cross- domain DR grading. Instead of trusting prediction confidence or estimating a target distribution, CF-NODE asks how each prediction responds under a controlled intervention on the evidence supporting it. CF-NODE ranks internal spatial nodes using model-derived attention, feature magnitude, and node-set similarity, progressively attenuates the highest-ranked nodes, and uses the stability of the resulting expected-grade response to apply a bounded calibration of the predicted grade distribution. The framework is fully frozen and adapts every image independently using only geometric views and a fixed source-derived prior, requiring no target-derived information or model updates. We evaluate CF-NODE on five external DR datasets under repeated-seed evaluation against TENT, EATA, SAR, and T3A. CF-NODE outperforms all four methods with statistically significant improvements over the second-best method, improves AUC on every target domain, and attains the highest average AUC and macro-F1, delivering stronger grade discrimination together with more balanced recognition across DR severity levels. These results demonstrate that counterfactual intervention sensitivity provides consistent and deployment-ready domain robustness for single-image clinical inference.

</details>


### [240] [Rank Measures of Fine-Tuning Updates Need a Noise Baseline](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22438)
*Muhammad Usman Altaf*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出用秩衡量微调权重更新ΔW时必须有噪声基线：更新是"少数强方向+长尾"，计数方向略低于随机矩阵，稳定秩则远低于，二者都对；该模式在13个≤8B模型对上成立，且并非对齐特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文献常用秩来概括微调对语言模型的权重更新ΔW，但缺乏参照基线，导致把"低秩"误读为有意义的现象（如对齐或后训练浅表性）。

Method: 将常用秩指标与三类参照比较：同形状随机矩阵、预训练权重、以及对齐内容去除后的匹配微调；并在不同数据（指令/Wikipedia/代码/乱序文本）与DPO标签随机化条件下做控制实验。

Result: 计数型秩指标仅略低于噪声，稳定秩则远低于；两者由同一奇异值解释，反映少数强方向加长尾。13对发布模型（≤8B）均如此。指令数据不比对wikip/代码更突出；DPO真实与半随机标签更新相同；乱序文本的更新最集中。随机同尺寸更新几乎不改有效秩却毁掉模型；基于更新有效秩的编辑无可测效果。

Conclusion: 权重更新的秩度量必须配噪声基线，关于对齐的结论必须有无对齐内容的对照。

Abstract: Studies of what fine-tuning does to a language model often summarise the weight update $ΔW$ by its rank. We compare the rank measures used for this against the same measures on a random matrix of the same shape, and against two harder references: the pretrained weights, and matched fine-tunes without alignment content. Measures that count directions put our fine-tuning updates only a little below noise; stable rank, computed from the same singular values, puts them far below. Both are right: an update has a few strong directions on top of a long tail. The pattern holds for thirteen released pairs up to 8B parameters, and it is not a mark of alignment: with training held fixed, instruction data does not stand out from Wikipedia or code, DPO gives the same update whether its preference labels are real or half swapped at random (one model, modest preference strength), and scrambled text gives the most concentrated update of all. Applied to a recent claim that post-training is superficial because the effective rank of the weights barely changes, the baselines show that a random update of the same size leaves that rank almost unchanged while wrecking the model, and that an edit built on the effective rank of the update has no measurable effect in our tests. Rank measures of weight updates need a noise baseline, and claims about alignment need a control without alignment content.

</details>


### [241] [Sparse Autoencoders Can Induce Local Geometry for Mitigating Catastrophic Forgetting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22439)
*Kamil Faber,Katarzyna Filus,Łukasz Pawela*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SAGA 将每个任务边界训练的稀疏自编码器转化为对表示漂移的局部低秩约束，实现更优的稳定性-可塑性权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 监督持续学习存在灾难性遗忘，适应新任务会导致表示漂移并丢失旧知识。核心问题是：应当约束哪些表示变化、同时保持可塑性。

Method: 提出 Sparse Autoencoder Geometric Anchoring (SAGA)：在任务边界训练 SAE，将其转换为局部低秩的表示漂移约束。回放样本决定约束施加位置，编码器雅可比的主右奇异方向决定惩罚哪些变化；所得几何依赖输入，且无需保留 SAE 即可用于后续任务训练。理论上有与潜在码匹配的局部关系、谱截断误差定义，以及冻结读出漂移的条件界。

Result: 在 ER、DER++、ER-ACE、SGD 基线中，配合回放与快照历史，在三个预训练 ViT-B/16 基准上取得最高平均 Class-IL 准确率和最低平均遗忘，较最强常规基线在 CIFAR-100、CUB-200、ImageNet-R 上分别提升 12.15、4.79、3.22 个百分点；从头训练结果参差，秩消融与几何控制实验表明 SAE 诱导的低秩几何提供了有效的权衡。

Conclusion: SAE 诱导的低秩几何可为持续学习提供有效的稳定性-可塑性权衡，在预训练模型场景下显著优于基线，但从头训练场景效果尚不稳定。

Abstract: Catastrophic forgetting remains a challenge in supervised continual learning, as adapting to new tasks causes representation drift and loss of previously learned information. This raises the question of which representational changes should be constrained while preserving plasticity. We therefore introduce Sparse Autoencoder Geometric Anchoring (SAGA), which converts a Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) trained at each task boundary into local, low-rank constraints on representation drift. Replay examples specify where the constraints apply, while leading right singular directions of the encoder Jacobian specify which changes are penalized. The resulting geometry is input dependent and can be retained without keeping the SAE for subsequent tasks' training. We establish its local relation to latent code matching, define its spectral truncation error, and derive a conditional bound on frozen-readout drift. With replay and snapshot history, the method achieves the highest mean Class-IL accuracy and lowest mean forgetting among the evaluated ER, DER++, ER-ACE, and SGD baselines on three pretrained ViT-B/16 benchmarks, with accuracy gains of 12.15, 4.79, and 3.22 percentage points over the strongest conventional baseline on CIFAR-100, CUB-200, and ImageNet-R, respectively. From scratch results are more mixed, while rank ablations and geometry controls show that SAE-induced low-rank geometry offers useful stability-plasticity trade-offs.

</details>


### [242] [Tool Recommendation for Multi-Step Agents: Finding Every Tool a Task Needs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23707)
*Sam Partee,River Stevens,Thierry Damiba,Valerie Fanelle*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出并部署了 Tool Recommendation 系统：通过三个固定工具的接口，让智能体在第 8,200 个工具规模下也可全部调用，并在真实计费场景中降低 token 与成本且不损失任务完成率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多步智能体任务缺一个工具即失败，但所需工具过多无法全部列出：平台约 8,200 个工具的定义总长超过任何被评测模型的上下文窗口，需要一种在固定接口下提供全部工具的方案。

Method: 在智能体与工具之间的网关层部署三工具固定接口的推荐系统；每次调用以终端用户自身凭证执行，并依据用户对每个服务的授权以及智能体可用工具范围进行校验。评估结合公开检索基准 ToolRet 与按计费的端到端会话成本，并在 Codex、Claude Code 的配对多步工作流中测试。

Result: ToolRet 上，将查询所需工具全部放入前十的频率比 BM25 高 57%，并与规模达自身九倍的已发表系统相比具有优势。配对多步流程中，首轮推荐在 93% 的 Codex 会话中覆盖全部必需工具；相对固定 100 工具列表，输入 token 在 Codex 下减少 17%、Claude Code 下减少 40%，14 次运行的总账单全部下降（最高 40%），任务完成率不变。

Conclusion: 固定接口的工具推荐可在超大工具集下兼顾可扩展性、授权安全与成本效益，是可行且已落地的方案。

Abstract: A multi-step agent task fails when a single tool it needs is missing, yet the tools an agent may need are too many to list: the roughly 8,200 tools on the platform we study have definitions that together exceed the context window of any model we evaluate. We present Tool Recommendation, a deployed system that gives an agent all of them, hundreds of times more than a typical MCP server exposes, through a fixed interface of three tools. It runs at the gateway between agent and tools, executing every call under the end user's own credentials and checking it against the user's consent for each service and the tools the agent may use. We evaluate it on both a public retrieval benchmark and billed end-to-end session cost. On ToolRet, Tool Recommendation places every tool a query needs in the top ten 57% more often than BM25, a lexical ranking that commercial tool search offers, and compares favorably with published systems up to nine times its size. In paired multi-step workflows, its first recommendation covered every required tool in 93% of Codex sessions, and against a fixed list of 100 tools it cut input tokens by 17% with Codex and 40% with Claude Code and the total bill in all 14 runs, by up to 40%, with no change in task completion.

</details>


### [243] [Lean4AgenticRL: Advancing Agentic RL with Verifiable Multi-level Process Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22448)
*Ruida Wang,Gerald Friedland,Tong Zhang,Chris Kong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Lean4AgenticRL 框架，用 Lean4 统一形式化多级过程奖励，训练出 LAR-9B/27B 模型，在终端任务上显著超越同规模模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前 LLM 智能体强化学习主要依赖高层结果奖励，缺乏对底层工具调用和中层工作流阶段奖励的考虑，导致训练效率低。

Method: 1) 构建问题专属工作流系统，平衡智能体能力与执行可控性；2) 在工作流形式化与通用验证框架内，用 Lean4 对每级奖励做形式化标注；3) 采用按工作流阶段归一化的 GRPO 算法进行多级过程奖励的智能体 RL。

Result: 训练出 LAR-9B/27B；LAR-27B 在 TerminalBench-2.1 达到 77.3%；平均比基座模型高 9.89%，比已知同规模第二名高 5.07%。

Conclusion: 将形式化方法（Lean4）引入开放式智能体 RL 具有潜力，多级过程奖励能有效提升 LLM 的 SWE 与终端使用能力。

Abstract: Enhancing the agentic capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) to tackle complex software engineering (SWE) and general terminal-usage problems is a pressing challenge. Current state-of-the-art LLMs often go through large-scale agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL). However, they mostly rely on high-level outcome rewards, with minimal consideration of low-level toolcall and mid-level workflow-stage rewards, which makes the training less effective. To overcome this limitation, we propose **Lean4AgenticRL**, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first framework that grounds multi-level process rewards in the unified Lean4 formalization schema for open-ended agentic RL. **Lean4AgenticRL** first builds a *problem-specific workflow* system that balances the agent's own capability and controllability during execution, laying the foundation for further verification. Subsequently, our workflow formalization and multi-level reward annotation methods enable agent behavior verification within a general harness system. It provides multi-level rewards to support more effective agentic RL with the workflow-stage-normalized GRPO algorithm. Using **Lean4AgenticRL**, we train **LAR-9B/27B**, a family of models with enhanced agentic capability. Extensive experiments indicate that our model outperforms the leading model of similar size. **LAR-27B** achieves **77.3%** on TerminalBench-2.1. On average, our models outperform the base model by **9.89%** and surpass the second-best model of comparable size we know by **5.07%**. These results indicate the potential of integrating formal methods in enhancing open-ended agentic RL.

</details>


### [244] [Contracting with an Agent under Model Mismatch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23402)
*Elif Yılmaz,Jakub Tłuczek,Victor Villin,Christos Dimitrakakis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究信念错配下的委托-代理MDP，主代理利用真实转移模型设计合约以诱导理想长期收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典委托-代理假设代理人了解环境，但现实中代理人可能对转移模型有错误信念，导致系统性次优决策，需要主代理在模型错配下重新设计合约。

Method: 提出委托-代理马尔可夫决策过程（PAMDP）框架：主代理与信念可能错误的代理人重复交互，主代理掌握真实转移模型，并据此设计考虑代理人信念与激励的合约；刻画模型错配下的合约设计。

Result: 刻画了模型错配情形下的合约设计，并给出使主代理在代理人环境理解不准确时仍能获得理想长期收益的框架。

Conclusion: 主代理可借助真实模型信息与合约设计，在代理人信念失配下仍有效对齐激励并获得良好长期收益。

Abstract: In the classical principal-agent setting, the principal delegates some task to the agent, who receives a payment conditioned on the outcome of the task, which in turn benefits the principal. To align their objectives, the principal designs a contract that incentivizes the agent to take actions beneficial to the principal. In practice, however, the agent may act under misspecified beliefs about the underlying environment, leading to systematically suboptimal decisions. In this work, we study this problem through a principal-agent Markov Decision Process (PAMDP), in which the principal repeatedly interacts with an agent whose transition model may differ from the true environment dynamics. The principal has access to the true transition model and designs contracts that account for the agent's belief and incentives. We characterize contract design under model mismatch and develop a framework that enables the principal to induce desirable long-term benefits even though the agent has a potentially inaccurate understanding of the environment.

</details>


### [245] [Progressive Misalignment Can Emerge from Benign Recursive Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22467)
*Karim Abdel Sadek,Federico Di Gennaro,Fanny Yang*

Main category: cs.LG
