The two types of knowledge are naturally complementary: universal semantics describe the common patterns of tabular data across domains, while the domain-specific features capture the inherent distributions of normal and anomalous behaviors in the target dataset. A prototype-conditioned modulation mechanism is then designed to effectively integrate the two types of features, allowing them to reinforce each other for improved anomaly detection. Extensive experiments on public datasets show that the proposed method outperforms competitive methods when only eight labeled anomalies are available in the training procedure.

</details>


### [353] [Logic-Guided Graph Denoising Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23766)
*Samuel Cognolato,Luciano Serafini,Alessandro Sperduti,Andrea Cavallaro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出用一阶逻辑(FOL)规则通过分类器引导将领域知识注入图扩散模型，推理时引导去噪轨迹满足结构约束，大幅提升生成图对本体约束的满足率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图扩散模型难以精确捕获具有严格结构约束的图分布，会生成不合法的图。需要一种能表达并强制这些约束、且可解释的方式将领域知识融入生成过程。

Method: 采用分类器引导：将FOL规则定义为模糊、可微的目标函数，在预训练图扩散模型的推理阶段用其引导去噪轨迹优化，只需指定FOL约束即可施加控制，无需重训练。

Result: 以知识图谱生成为任务，将领域本体作为结构约束，对比无约束生成，逻辑引导框架显著提高了生成图满足本体约束的比例。

Conclusion: FOL+分类器引导是一种有效、通用且可解释的手段，可在推理时让预训练图扩散模型符合领域结构约束。

Abstract: Graph diffusion models are competitive approaches for generating complex graph-structured data. However, when such distributions have strict structural constraints, diffusion models may fail to capture them exactly, resulting in the generation of invalid graphs. In this paper, we propose a method for grounding graph diffusion models in domain-specific knowledge via First Order Logic (FOL), leveraging its expressive and interpretable formalism to impose structural constraints on the generative process. We incorporate domain knowledge using classifier guidance, a technique that conditions the diffusion model's distribution on external variables to exert control over the sampled data. During the generative process, classifier guidance steers the denoising trajectory to optimize an objective function, which we define as a fuzzy and differentiable relaxation of the logical rules. Our methodology requires only the specification of constraints in FOL, whose satisfaction is encouraged at inference time to guide a pre-trained generative model. We evaluate our approach by comparing the unconditional generation of knowledge graphs with our logic-guided framework, which incorporates domain ontologies as structural constraints during inference. This approach significantly increases the proportion of generated graphs that satisfy the ontological constraints.

</details>


### [354] [Explainable Machine Learning Analysis of Temperature Effects on Mechanical Strength of Fiber-Reinforced High-Performance Concrete](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23811)
*Jagaran Chakma,Zhiguang Zhou,Badhan Chakma,Priyanta Chakma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文利用1204条实验数据构建数据驱动框架，比较八种机器学习模型预测高温暴露下纤维增强高性能混凝土的抗压强度，集成模型表现最优（R²≈0.903），并用SHAP与部分依赖分析揭示温度为首要影响因素，最终开发GUI工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纤维增强高性能混凝土在温度暴露下的抗压强度受配合比、纤维特性、养护条件和温度等多因素复杂耦合影响，传统方法难以准确预测，亟需精确且可解释的数据驱动方法。

Method: 构建包含1204条实验记录（涵盖多样材料设计与暴露工况）的数据集；评估八种机器学习模型；采用Shapley加性解释（SHAP）与部分依赖分析进行模型可解释性分析；并将最优模型集成到基于Python的图形用户界面中。

Result: 集成方法普遍优于单一学习器；梯度提升与极端梯度提升在未见数据上表现最佳，R²均为0.903；梯度提升RMSE最低（6.67 MPa），极端梯度提升MAE（3.97 MPa）与MAPE（10.60%）最低。SHAP分析显示温度是影响抗压强度的首要因素，其次为细骨料、减水剂、水泥用量、水胶比和用水量；强度随温度升高显著下降，但劣化程度取决于具体配合比设计。

Conclusion: 研究提供了一种精确且可解释的评估温度相关抗压强度的方法，并借助Python GUI实现快速预测，可支撑纤维增强高性能混凝土的实用化数据驱动设计。

Abstract: Predicting the compressive strength of fiber-reinforced high-performance concrete subjected to temperature exposure is challenging because to the intricate interdependencies of mixture composition, fiber properties, curing conditions, and temperature. A data-driven framework to predict compressive strength utilizing 1,204 experimental records containing a diverse array of material designs and exposure situations. This study evaluates eight machine-learning models and demonstrate that ensemble approaches routinely surpass individual learners. Both gradient boosting and extreme gradient boosting exhibit superior performance on unseen data, each attaining a R^2 of 0.903. Gradient boosting produces the minimal root mean square error (6.67 MPa), whereas extreme gradient boosting achieves the lowest mean absolute error (3.97 MPa) and mean absolute percentage error (10.60%). The models are further interpreted utilizing Shapley additive explanations and partial dependence analysis, which reveal temperature as the primary factor influencing compressive strength, succeeded by fine aggregate, superplasticizer, cement content, water-to-binder ratio, and water content. Strength diminishes significantly with rising temperature, albeit the extent of deterioration is contingent upon the specific combination design. The best performing models are subsequently implemented in a Python-based graphical user interface for expedited prediction. Our findings offer a precise and comprehensible methodology for evaluating temperature-dependent compressive strength and facilitate the practical, data-driven design of fiber-reinforced high-performance concrete.

</details>


### [355] [Learning Personalized Memory Gating from Delayed One-Sided Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23812)
*Kaixuan Ji,Zixiang Chen,Wenting Zhao,Cheng Qian,Heng Wang,Weizhi Zhang,Jielin Qiu,Liangwei Yang,Quanquan Gu,Silvio Savarese,Shelby Heinecke,Huan Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究事实级记忆门控：用基于检索的标注判断每条事实是否会被后续复用，并将在线记忆门控建模为带延迟单边反馈的上下文"苹果品尝"问题，提出 Warm-Start UCB 结合离线学习与在线个性化自适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期记忆让语言模型智能体能够个性化未来交互，但记忆库容量有限，无法保留所有抽取事实。现有记忆门控策略在用户间共享，无法刻画不同用户对未来事实复用的差异模式。

Method: 1）提出基于检索的标注策略，按事实后续是否被检索并写入回答为其打标签；2）将在线记忆门控形式化为带延迟单边反馈的 contextual apple tasting 问题；3）提出 Warm-Start UCB，将已有数据的离线学习与面向当前用户的在线自适应相结合。

Result: 理论分析给出：当延迟窗口至多 O(√T) 时，高概率遗憾上界为 Õ(Tε ∧ d√T)，其中 T 为总轮数、ε 为初始化误差、d 为特征维度。实验表明，在不同记忆预算与历史长度下，该方法均优于所有基线。

Conclusion: 面向事实级的个性化记忆门控是可行且有前景的方向，Warm-Start UCB 兼顾离线先验与在线自适应，在理论与实验上均表现良好。

Abstract: Long-term memory enables language-model agents to personalize future interactions, but a finite memory bank cannot preserve every extracted fact. Existing memory gating policies are typically shared across users and therefore fail to account for user-specific patterns of future reuse. In this paper, we study memory gating at the fact level. We first propose a retrieval-based labeling strategy that labels each fact by whether it is later retrieved and incorporated into responses. We then formulate online memory gating as contextual apple tasting with delayed one-sided feedback, and propose Warm-Start UCB, which combines offline learning from existing data with online adaptation to the current user. Our theoretical analysis establishes a high-probability regret upper bound of $\tilde{O}(Tε\wedge d\sqrt{T})$ when the delay window is at most $O(\sqrt{T})$, where $T$ is the total number of rounds, $ε$ is the initialization error, $d$ is the dimension of the feature map, and $\tilde{O}(\cdot)$ hides constant and poly-logarithmic factors. The results of our experiment demonstrate that our method outperforms all baselines under different memory budgets and history lengths, establishing it as a promising personalized memory gating policy.

</details>


### [356] [CocoRNA: Collective RNA Design with Cooperative Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23820)
*Tianmeng Hu,Biao Luo,Ke Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CocoRNA：一种合作式多智能体强化学习框架，用于RNA反向设计，将设计任务分解为子问题并协作求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 设计能可靠折叠成特定二级结构的RNA序列对理解其生物功能至关重要，但仍是困难的计算问题；已有方法在复杂度和探索上受限。

Method: 将RNA反向设计任务分解为多个较小子问题，每个子问题由多个智能体协作求解，降低问题复杂度并增强设计策略探索；训练时采用集中式critic利用全局结构信息指导智能体，联合优化设计策略。

Result: 在Rfam数据集上，成功率和设计速度均显著优于现有最先进方法；且无需额外训练即可泛化到未见结构；在其他生物序列设计任务上也展现出有效性和广泛潜力。

Conclusion: CocoRNA学习到高质量的RNA设计策略，具备强泛化能力和广泛适用于复杂生物序列设计任务的潜力。

Abstract: Designing RNA sequences that reliably fold into specific secondary structures is essential for understanding their biological functions but remains a challenging computational problem. We propose CocoRNA, a cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for RNA inverse design. CocoRNA simplifies the design task by decomposing it into smaller sub-problems, each solved collaboratively by multiple agents. This approach reduces the complexity of the problem and improves the exploration of design policies. During training, a centralized critic uses global structural information to guide the agents, enabling them to jointly optimize their design strategies. As a result, CocoRNA learns high-quality RNA design policies that generalize effectively to unseen structures without additional training. Experiments on the Rfam dataset demonstrate that CocoRNA substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both success rate and design speed. Further experiments on other biological sequence design tasks highlight the effectiveness and broad potential of CocoRNA for complex design tasks.

</details>


### [357] [Waiting Buys Exactly Two Moments: Endogenous Identification in Prediction-Driven Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23830)
*Rama AlHamidi,Rasul Khanbayov,Erchin Serpedin,Hasan Kurban*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 固定预防性资源下的“何时帮助谁”问题中，等待可揭示风险但高风险个体先流失；论文刻画了重复噪声信号与风险相关流失下的这一权衡，并给出矩识别、时机遗憾与实验证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 规划者预算固定，需决定帮助对象与时机。等待能获取更多风险信息，但干预机会随高风险个体先离开而消失，二者构成核心权衡，而现有方法不清楚这种数据究竟能识别什么、能否带来更优配置。

Method: 在规范模型中证明长度τ的观测前缀恰好识别潜在风险矩m_j=E[p^j]（j=0,…,2τ−1），每多观测一期多识别两个矩；用观测等价构造建立任意样本量下固定观测长度都存在不可避免的时机遗憾，并用精确证书判断所有相容总体是否共享唯一最优日期；通过匹配实验分离估计、bootstrap平均与遗憾加权三种效应。

Result: 这些矩可识别幸存者的下期平均流失，但不一定识别配置福利或优先干预者的流失；实验显示更长观测常能消解时机歧义，但最优日期可能已过；bootstrap平均与早停改善决策，而遗憾加权在合并均方遗憾上无增益。

Conclusion: 更好的统计拟合不必带来更好的配置福利；识别能力与决策价值之间存在根本差距，实践中应重视bootstrap平均与早停，而非单纯追求遗憾加权式的拟合优化。

Abstract: A planner with a fixed budget of preventive help must decide whom to help and when. Waiting reveals risk but removes intervention opportunities as higher-risk individuals leave first. We characterize this tradeoff under repeated noisy signals and risk-dependent attrition: in the canonical model, a length-$τ$ observation prefix identifies exactly the latent risk moments $m_j=\mathbb E[p^j]$ for $j=0,\ldots,2τ-1$, buying two new moments per additional period. These identify average next-period attrition among survivors but need not identify allocation welfare or attrition among those prioritized for treatment. Our observationally equivalent constructions establish unavoidable timing regret at any sample size for a fixed observation length, while exact certificates determine whether all compatible populations share a unique optimal date. Matched experiments separate the effects of estimation, bootstrap averaging, and regret weighting. Longer observation often resolves timing ambiguity, but the optimal date may already have passed. In our experiments, bootstrap averaging and early stopping improve decisions, while regret weighting adds no improvement in pooled mean squared regret: better statistical fit need not yield better allocation welfare. The code and artifacts are available at https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/waiting-buys-two-moments.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [358] [Structured Authority Injection: Persistent Human Control for LLM Agents via Typed MCP Overrides](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22373)
*Ryan Tran,YueMing Zhang,Lingfeng Tao,Nan Yang,Shengjie Xu,Yu Yin,Shuai Xu,Wenlu Zhang,Hailu Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出结构化权威注入(SAI)协议，通过类型化、schema校验的MCP工具调用注入操作者指令，并用排名的权威上下文置顶于每次LLM提示，实现跨规划周期的持久人工控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体作为分布式/多智能体系统的自主编排者时存在"控制缺口"：缺乏协议级机制让人类操作者注入跨规划周期持续有效的约束性指令。自由文本覆盖存在歧义解释（缺少schema校验）和权威衰减（指令在累积上下文中逐渐失效）两大问题。

Method: SAI将操作者纠正通过类型化、schema校验的MCP工具调用路由，并维护一个排名的权威上下文置于每个LLM提示最前。定义三类覆盖（Constraint约束、Priority优先级、Strategy策略），各具不同持久化语义，并通过规划过程无法访问的定向权威通道强制执行显式优先顺序。无需微调或访问模型权重，适用于支持MCP工具使用的指令微调LLM。

Result: 在9个LLM和针对智能体失效模式的8个场景上评估，显示减少了歧义指令解释、缓解了跨规划迭代的权威衰减，在最强模型中提示开销更低（依模型和场景最高降低38%），但收益在不同模型间差异较大。

Conclusion: SAI为需要显式且持久人工控制的智能体系统提供了一个通用设计模式。

Abstract: LLM-based agents are increasingly used as autonomous orchestrators in distributed and multi-agent systems, yet a control gap remains: no protocol-level mechanism allows human operators to inject binding directives that persist across planning cycles. Free-text overrides suffer from ambiguous interpretation due to lack of schema validation and from authority erosion as operator instructions lose influence within accumulating context. We propose Structured Authority Injection (SAI), a protocol that addresses these issues by routing operator corrections through typed, schema-validated Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool calls and maintaining a ranked authority context prepended to each LLM prompt. SAI defines three override classes (Constraint, Priority, and Strategy) with distinct persistence semantics and an explicit precedence order enforced via a directed authority channel inaccessible to the planning process. The method requires no model fine-tuning or access to model weights and applies to instruction-tuned LLMs supporting MCP tool use. Evaluation across nine LLMs and eight scenarios targeting agent failure modes shows reduced ambiguous directive interpretation and mitigated authority decay across planning iterations, with lower prompt overhead in the strongest models (up to 38% depending on model and scenario), though benefit varies substantially across models. SAI provides a general design pattern for agent systems requiring explicit and persistent human control.

</details>


### [359] [Rethinking User Encoders: Routing Diffusion States for Scenario-Adaptive User Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22400)
*Junru Zhang,Jinyong Wen,Bin Dou,Wuliang Huang,Baokun Wang,Yu Cheng,Weiqiang Wang,Cheng Peng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出FINDERS框架，利用扩散语言模型(dLLM)的迭代去噪过程作为多粒度重构空间，结合可学习meta-slots与场景查询驱动的路由器，将异构用户行为日志转化为可路由的跨模态语义与模态特异的用户因子表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的用户编码器以自回归方式将异构行为日志压缩为静态表示，单向约束限制双向信息流，阻碍跨模态交互与多源信号联合保留，导致静态表示难以适配下游场景差异化的证据需求。

Method: 以dLLM迭代去噪为多粒度重构空间，设计包含denoise、factorize、route、compress四步的框架：可学习meta-slots将互补去噪状态组织为可迁移跨模态语义与模态特异行为因子；构建含显式行为理由的BehaviorQA语料提供有依据的监督；轻量路由器依据场景查询，经输入级残差通路动态强化相关slot方向，再进行跨源融合与压缩。

Result: 在十个工业场景的离线实验与在线A/B测试中，FINDERS在统一设置与场景自适应设置下均持续优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: 该工作将dLLM的能力拓展至语言生成之外，证明其作为用户表示学习器的巨大潜力。

Abstract: Existing large language model (LLM)-based user encoders serialize heterogeneous behavioral logs and compress them into static representations through autoregressive (AR) prediction. However, their unidirectional constraint limits bidirectional information flow, hindering cross-modal interactions and the joint preservation of multi-source signals. Consequently, the learned static representations struggle to accommodate the distinct evidence requirements of diverse downstream scenarios. We address these limitations by unlocking the iterative denoising process of diffusion language models (dLLMs) as a multi-granularity reconstruction space. Based on this insight, we propose FINDERS (FactorIzatioN of Diffusion statEs for Routing across Scenarios), a router-equipped dLLM framework comprising four operations: denoise, factorize, route, and compress. Learnable meta-slots organize complementary denoising states into transferable cross-modal semantics and modality-specific behavioral factors. To provide grounded supervision, we construct BehaviorQA, a large-scale corpus containing explicit behavioral rationales. Guided by scenario queries, a lightweight router dynamically emphasizes relevant slot directions via an input-level residual pathway before cross-source fusion and final compression. Extensive experiments and online A/B tests across ten industrial scenarios demonstrate that FINDERS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both unified and scenario-adaptive settings. This work effectively pushes the boundaries of dLLMs beyond language generation, demonstrating their immense potential as powerful user representation learners.

</details>


### [360] [From Events to Reasoning: Hierarchical Rule Composition over Explicit States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22403)
*Cheng Lyu,Xueqi Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出事件推理系统（ERS），以显式事件图作为推理状态并结合语义特征提名与规则/任务条件约束，保证推理路径可证、依赖可存续、前提变更可修订；在结构化事件图上实现最长12步依赖链、将无关执行域操作从32降至0、负例零无支撑输出，并以复合高层控制规则降低51.6%推理耗时。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理系统不应只输出结论，而应给出可辩护的论证：每一步操作须在现有事实下可接受，中间结果的依赖须存活至路径终点，前提变化时路径须可修订。现有系统常缺乏对可接受性、依赖存续与修订的形式化保障，也难以在有限规则库下灵活组织合法推理路径。

Method: 将推理状态表示为显式事件图；语义特征提名候选对象与规则绑定，由声明的规则条件与任务条件决定哪些可执行，从而排除违反时期、单位或证据约束的候选。低层规则提供可复用的局部变换，递归可组合的高层控制规则依据当前目标、信息缺口与预算组织子目标与合法路径，使有限规则库被重新绑定为未曾完整存储的路径。形式化了可接受转移、任务相关控制、组合表达能力、依赖保持的修订，以及可达解与预算约束控制器所求解之间的差距。

Result: 在结构化事件图上构建了最长12步的依赖链；随前瞻增至16，无关执行域操作由32降至0；24个负例中未产生无支撑目标输出；规则冻结条件下通过12/12聚焦检查（含9个涉及未见输入/路径组合的可接受推导与3个有据拒绝）及6/6事实变更案例；在14个联合求解的开发任务上，动态子目标配置比单层全局控制在各自冻结设置下减少51.6%推理墙钟时间。

Conclusion: ERS通过事件图状态、约束驱动的规则执行与可组合控制规则，实现了可证、依赖保持且可修订的推理，并在控制效率与验证方面优于单层全局控制，展示有限规则库经重新绑定可支撑多样合法推理路径。

Abstract: What a reasoning system emits is a conclusion; what it owes is a justification. Producing one requires every operation to be admissible on the facts actually available, the dependencies of intermediate results to survive to the end of the path, and the path to be revised when a premise changes. We present the Event Reasoning System (ERS), in which the reasoning state is an explicit event graph. Semantic features nominate candidate objects and rule bindings, and declared rule and task conditions decide which may execute, so candidates that violate the represented period, unit, or evidence constraints cannot enter an accepted reasoning path. Low-level rules provide reusable local transformations, and recursively composable high-level control rules organize subgoals and legal paths under the current goal, information gaps, and budget; a finite library is thereby rebound into paths never stored as complete solutions. We formalize admissible transitions, task-dependent control, compositional expressivity, dependency-preserving revision, and the gap between reachable solutions and those a budgeted controller finds. On structured-event graphs, ERS builds dependency chains of up to twelve steps, cuts irrelevant executed domain operations from 32 to 0 as lookahead grows to 16, and produces no unsupported target output across 24 negative cases; with rules frozen, it passes 12/12 focused checks comprising nine accepted derivations involving unseen input/path combinations and three justified refusals, as well as 6/6 fact-change cases. On fourteen jointly solved development tasks, the recorded dynamic subgoal configuration uses 51.6% less inference wall-clock time than single-level global control under their respective frozen settings.

</details>


### [361] [Algorithm Modelization: Transforming Optimization Algorithms into Evolvable Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23161)
*Jian Yao,Zhiyao Zhang,Yichen Li,Xingyu Wu,Kay Chen Tan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"算法模型化"新范式，把迭代算法视为可训练模型，将算法执行轨迹当作计算经验来学习；首个实现将迭代优化建模为自回归过程，用维度无关的种群-时序架构与"模仿到超越"学习框架，得到可泛化、可进化的优化器模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统上算法需反复人工设计为程序，知识与经验难以积累。作者希望算法能力能像模型一样通过学习获得、复用并持续进化，而非每次重新设计。

Method: 提出 Algorithm Modelization 范式：以算法执行轨迹为"计算经验"，学习算法状态的迭代演化。首个实现把迭代优化转为自回归生成过程（前代种群作为上下文生成下一代），设计维度无关的种群-时序架构捕捉种群交互与迭代动态；并采用"模仿到超越"(imitation-to-surpassing)学习框架，先从异构教师算法模仿，再通过优化反馈直接改进优化器。

Result: 模型化优化器不仅能复现单一算法，还能融合多种异构搜索知识于一体；经后续改进后优化能力更强；并能跨问题泛化，且推广到明显更大、未见过的维度。

Conclusion: 算法模型化使算法能力可通过学习累积，新算法与求解经验可成为持续提升模型的训练资源，指向从人工设计算法走向能学习、泛化并在计算经验中进化的一般算法模型。

Abstract: Can algorithms be learned and evolved as models, rather than repeatedly redesigned as programs? We explore this question by introducing Algorithm Modelization, a new paradigm that turns iterative algorithms into trainable models. Its central idea is to regard algorithm execution trajectories as computational experience: by learning how algorithmic states evolve over iterations, a model can internalize the knowledge embodied in existing algorithms, reproduce their computational behaviors, and further evolve beyond them through training. As a first realization of this paradigm, we modelize iterative optimization as an autoregressive process, where preceding generations constitute the computational context for generating the next population. We develop a dimension-independent population-temporal architecture to capture both population interactions and iterative dynamics, together with an imitation-to-surpassing learning framework that first acquires algorithmic knowledge from heterogeneous teachers and then improves the resulting optimizer directly through optimization feedback. The modelized optimizer consequently goes beyond reproducing individual algorithms: it consolidates heterogeneous search knowledge into a single trainable model, achieves stronger optimization capability through subsequent improvement, and generalizes its acquired knowledge across problems and substantially larger unseen dimensions. More fundamentally, Algorithm Modelization makes algorithmic capability accumulable through learning, where new algorithms and problem-solving experience can become training resources for progressively improving the model. Our results establish a promising path from manually designed algorithms toward general algorithm models that learn, generalize, and evolve from computational experience.

</details>


### [362] [ECHOES: Seeing Beyond the Current Image via Recursive History Compression and Privileged On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22408)
*Tengda Guo,Jiawang Hu,Yifei Tao,Yin Wang,Haotian Hu,Fanyi Wang,Liujuan Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ECHOES 利用训练期的特权多图信息做 on-policy 蒸馏，引导 GUI 智能体把视觉历史压缩为递归更新的文本状态，在部署时不保留历史截图仍保持长程性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程 GUI 智能体依赖视觉历史维持任务状态，但保留历史截图会大幅增加视觉 token 与推理成本；而纯文本摘要又可能丢失关键状态，损害长程可靠性。因此需要在低成本与状态保真之间取得平衡。

Method: 提出 Compression-Think-Action（CTA）格式，递归更新文本历史状态并进行推理；同一模型以特权多图输入作为教师，对学生生成的 CTA rollout 做 token 级 on-policy 蒸馏；用 Perception-Memory Fidelity (PMF) Gap 引导的 OPD-RL 框架动态平衡特权蒸馏与任务奖励优化，并周期性更新教师；另构建 ECHOESBMK 诊断基准（源自真实失败轨迹）评估视觉感知与跨模态状态保持。

Result: 在四个 GUI 基准及 ECHOESBMK 上，任务性能与记忆保真度均显著提升；部署时不保留历史截图即可达到有竞争力的性能，并获得较好的性能—推理成本折中，同时对未见视觉规划任务展现正向零样本迁移。

Conclusion: 训练期特权视觉信息可有效替代部署期的历史截图，实现高效且可靠的长程 GUI 智能体；配套的 PMF 诊断基准补足了现有评测对跨模态状态保持的缺失。

Abstract: Long-horizon GUI agents rely on visual history to maintain task states, but retaining historical screenshots increases visual-token usage and inference costs, while textual summaries can discard critical state information, undermining long-horizon reliability. We propose ECHOES, which leverages training-time privileged information to guide textual history compression and strengthen long-horizon reasoning. Specifically, ECHOES adopts a Compression-Think-Action (CTA) format to recursively update a textual history state and reason. The same model, given privileged multi-image inputs, serves as a teacher that provides dense token-level on-policy distillation on student-generated CTA rollouts. Our Perception-Memory Fidelity (PMF) Gap-guided OPD-RL framework dynamically balances privileged distillation and task-reward optimization, with periodic teacher updates supporting continued improvement. We further introduce ECHOESBMK, a fine-grained diagnostic benchmark derived from real GUI agent failure trajectories to jointly evaluate visual perception and cross-modal state retention. Experiments on four GUI benchmarks and ECHOESBMK demonstrate substantial gains in task performance and memory fidelity. Without retaining historical screenshots at deployment, ECHOES achieves competitive performance with a favorable performance-inference-cost trade-off and exhibits positive zero-shot transfer to unseen visual planning tasks.

</details>


### [363] [Sensitivity Analysis of Decision Rules in an Agent-Based Agro-Ecological Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22420)
*Benjamin Pianet,Baptiste Lesquoy,Paul Saves,Benoit Gaudou,Jean Villerd,Nicolas Verstaevel,Olivier Therond*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对农业生态智能体模型中参数呈决策树式分级结构的问题，提出将决策结构作为一等建模对象，构建MAELIA作物管理方案的层级设计空间，并提出随机森林监督的HSIC-ANOVA方法，实现原生树结构上的主效应与交互效应排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于智能体的农业生态系统模型适合支持决策，但要转化为可行动洞见，需识别哪些决策真正驱动系统行为。此类系统的参数并非扁平向量，而是决策树结构——许多参数仅在高层选择激活时才出现；经典全局敏感性分析假设输入在固定笛卡尔积上独立，在有分支的空间上不适定且存在构造性偏差。

Method: 以先进代理模型技术，将MAELIA高分辨率农业生态建模平台的作物管理行程编码为包含类别与数值变量的层级设计空间；提出一种专用的层级空间分析方法——随机森林监督的HSIC-ANOVA，在树上原生地对主效应与交互效应排序，并将极少激活与始终激活的决策置于同等地位。

Result: 将该方法应用于氮淋失、土壤有机碳变化与产量预测等仿真输出时，可获得可解释的、面向决策的解读。

Conclusion: 将决策结构视为一等建模对象并结合随机森林监督的HSIC-ANOVA，可在分级参数空间中实现无偏、可解释的敏感性分析，为农业生态模型的决策支持提供有效途径。

Abstract: Agent-based models are well-suited for modelling agro-ecological systems for decision-making, yet turning their simulations into actionable insight requires identifying which decisions actually drive the behaviours. In such a context, sensitivity analysis stumbles upon a structural feature of many complex systems: the parameters are not a flat vector but a decision tree in which many parameters appear only when a higher-level choice activates them. Classical global sensitivity analysis presupposes independent inputs over a fixed Cartesian product and is ill-posed on such a branched space and biased by construction. We instead treat the structure of the decisions as a first-class modelling object. Using advanced surrogate modelling techniques, we encode the crop-management itinerary of the high-resolution agro-ecological modelling platform MAELIA as a hierarchical design space featuring both categorical and numerical variables. We propose a novel dedicated method to analyse this kind of hierarchical space, a random-forest-supervised HSIC-ANOVA, which ranks main effects and interactions natively on the tree while placing rarely and always active decisions on an equal footing. We show how, when applied to simulation outputs such as nitrogen leaching, soil organic carbon variation, and yield predictions, it can deliver an interpretable, decision-oriented reading.

</details>


### [364] [PRIME: Towards Verifiable Evidence-Grounded Reasoning in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22426)
*Hamed Khosravi,Xiaoming Huo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 PRIME 框架，通过预先固定证据路径与独立账本校验，防止 LLM agent 在合规检查中得出未经证据支撑的结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent 用于核对记录是否符合组织要求时，常出现两类失败：必需检查已失败却仍接受记录，或满足于较弱结论而不尝试其他可行路径。

Method: PRIME（Precommitted Rules for Inference from Minimal Evidence）：检查前先固定证据路径，规定每种结论可如何被论证；由独立程序记录每项检查结果，拒绝结果无法支撑的结论，并提示或自动执行可支撑更强结论的检查。

Result: 480 个公共记录任务上，直接看要求的 agent 有 26.7% 任务给出无依据结论，PRIME 为 0；其指引与补充检查使合理结论平均分从仅拒绝时的 30.1 提升至满分 100 中的 59.2。

Conclusion: 在要求正确、检查位置已知且停止时预算充足的前提下，PRIME 能保证达到最强有据结论，显著优于普通 agent 与单纯拒绝策略。

Abstract: LLM agents are used to check records against an organization's requirements, for example whether a vulnerability report is ready for investigation. Requirements often allow several ways to be met, such as a severity rating with a curator-reviewed advisory or a published advisory link. Agents fail by accepting a report after a required check has failed, or by settling for a weaker conclusion without trying another way that could still succeed. We introduce PRIME (Precommitted Rules for Inference from Minimal Evidence). Before checking, it fixes evidence routes specifying how each conclusion may be justified. A separate program records each check result and refuses any conclusion the results do not justify. It also points the agent to checks that could justify a stronger conclusion, or runs them itself. PRIME reports only conclusions authorized by its rules and ledger. With correct requirements, exact checks at known locations, and sufficient budget at stopping, completion reaches the strongest supported conclusion. On 480 public-record tasks, an agent shown the requirements reported unjustified conclusions on 26.7% of tasks, while PRIME reported none. Its directions and added checks raised the average score for justified conclusions from 30.1, with refusal alone, to the maximum of 59.2 out of 100.

</details>


### [365] [From Natural Language Intent to Executable Control: Hierarchical Feedback-Guided LLM Planning for Multi-component Cyber-Physical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22441)
*Jinglin Dai,Jiawan Wang,Ruiqi Hong,Lei Bu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出分层反馈框架，用任务层和STL约束的一致性检查及执行层控制综合诊断反馈，引导LLM为CPS生成可执行计划，在7个异构多组件场景中成功率87.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM将自然语言指令翻译为CPS任务计划存在两个障碍：生成的计划可能误解或遗漏用户意图；逻辑上可行的计划在组件动力学、交互或安全约束下可能不可执行。现有LLM规划方法缺乏说明计划失败原因的信息性反馈，难以指导计划修订。

Method: 提出层次化反馈框架。让LLM同时生成结构化任务计划和对应的信号时序逻辑(STL)约束，设计可靠(sound)算法识别二者之间的确定矛盾并反馈用于修订不一致；在执行层，当控制综合失败时提取诊断信息（如被违反的约束、冲突的组件分配）反馈给LLM以指导任务重规划。

Result: 在7个异构多组件CPS场景中，框架能生成可执行计划及满足原始自然语言任务的可控执行，使用GPT-5时成功率达87.9%。

Conclusion: 分层、多类型的反馈机制有效弥合了LLM计划与CPS真实执行之间的差距，验证了反馈引导式重规划在异构CPS任务规划中的有效性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) provide a convenient interface for translating natural language commands into task plans for cyber-physical systems (CPSs). However, two gaps hinder their use for real execution: generated plans may misinterpret or omit the user's intent, and even a logically plausible plan may be infeasible under component dynamics, interactions, or safety constraints. Existing LLM-based planning approaches often lack informative feedback on why a generated plan fails, providing little guidance for revising the plan accordingly. To address these challenges, we present a hierarchical feedback framework that uses different types of feedback information to guide LLMs in generating executable plans for CPSs. We prompt LLMs to generate both a structured task plan and corresponding signal temporal logic (STL) constraints, and design a sound algorithm that identifies definite contradictions between them and provides feedback for revising inconsistencies. At the execution level, when control synthesis fails, we extract different types of diagnostic information, such as violated constraints and conflicting component assignments, and feed them back to guide task replanning. Experiments on seven heterogeneous multi-component CPS scenarios have shown that our framework can generate executable plans and feasible control executions that satisfy the original natural language missions with a success rate of 87.9% with GPT-5.

</details>


### [366] [Null Controls Are Necessary but Not Sufficient: Evaluating Acceptance Guards for Scientific Discovery and Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22445)
*Tianyu Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文指出自动化发现系统"通过检验"不等于"确证科学主张"，并发展四个可执行操作与三种判定标准，揭示两类"接受鸿沟"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化发现系统会提出科学解释并通过检验来决定接受与否，但"通过某项检验"未必能成立其意欲主张的正确解释。作者希望回答：检验所接受的是什么，以及接受之后是否真正带来可独立验证的科学后果。

Method: 提出四种改变物理描述的可执行操作：识别冗余(L1)、动力学粗粒化(L2)、结构迁移(L3)、由守恒失衡推断缺失量(L4)；并用零假设接受率(NAR)、正例接受率(PAR)与后果一致率(CAR)评估这些操作及三种可解释性设置；同时引入独立可观测保持检验与局部干预、消融作为对照。

Result: 把所有状态映射为零的平凡约简在129个公开混沌系统中有96%通过闭合性检验，但被可观测保持检验全部拒绝；在受控基准上组合准则接受24/24真约简、拒绝72/72零假设。语言与ESM-2中线性CKA在随机旋转下不变，而局部干预可区分真映射；稀疏自编码器中富集检验拒绝全部16个零假设，但独立消融仅支持45%的可评估富集特征（匹配对照0.5%）。

Conclusion: 存在两类接受鸿沟：描述性检验会接受科学上空洞的候选；被接受的候选也可能缺乏独立验证的后果。可靠的自动化发现须同时评估"检验接受了什么"与"它确立了何种科学后果"。

Abstract: Automated discovery systems propose scientific explanations and test which to accept. Does passing a test establish the intended claim? We develop four executable operations for changing physical descriptions: identifying redundancies (L1), coarse-graining dynamics (L2), transferring structure (L3), and inferring missing quantities from conservation imbalances (L4). We evaluate these operations and three interpretability settings through null acceptance (NAR), positive acceptance (PAR), and consequence agreement (CAR).
  A reduction mapping every state to zero predicts its own future perfectly. It passes closure on 96% of 129 public chaotic systems despite retaining no dynamical variation. An independent observable-preservation test rejects it throughout. On controlled benchmarks, the combined criteria accept 24/24 genuine reductions and reject 72/72 nulls. The other operations distinguish symmetries from redundancies, validate transfers, and reject spurious conservation imbalances. In language and ESM-2 protein models, linear CKA remains unchanged when a proposed correspondence is randomly rotated, whereas localized interventions distinguish genuine mappings from tested nulls. In sparse autoencoders, enrichment rejects all 16 tested nulls, yet independent ablation supports 45% of evaluable enriched features, compared with 0.5% of matched controls.
  These results reveal two acceptance gaps: descriptive tests can accept scientifically empty candidates, and accepted candidates can lack independently verified consequences. Reliable automated discovery requires evaluating both what a test accepts and the scientific consequences it establishes. Code and data: https://real-project-aether.github.io/project-aether/.

</details>


### [367] [Learnable Splines for Unstructured Neural Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22446)
*Vignesh Gopakumar,Zhuoyuan Wang,Ander Gray,Valentin Duruisseaux,Josh Williams,William Michael Edward Ellis,Nuno Nobre,Matthew Field,James Panayis,Alexander I. Blair,Andrew Davis,Stanislas Pamela,Robert Akers,Marc Peter Deisenroth,Anima Anandkumar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: L-SplineFNO 将 FNO 主干与稀疏可学习张量积 B 样条传递结合，在不规则网格与潜空间笛卡尔网格间高效转换，实现内存友好的大规模三维工程仿真神经算子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有网格型神经算子（如 FNO）假设均匀矩形网格，而工程仿真普遍使用大尺度、不规则、局部加密的网格；同时需要兼顾计算/内存效率与预测的可信性。

Method: 用 FNO 主干 + 稀疏可学习的张量积 B 样条传递，在非结构网格与潜空间笛卡尔网格间映射；采用局部归一化 scatter 规避解析样条变换的几何相关求解，同时天然保持紧支撑、单位分解与样条光滑性；以全局设计与运行参数为条件学习几何到场解映射；解析样条解码器结合 Bernstein 凸包与 Taylor 模型给出连续空间与不确定参数下的严格预测界。

Result: 在 6 个三维工程基准上取得高预测精度，内存与计算显著低于基线算子；单张 A100 上训练可扩展至 2660 万节点、推理 4600 万节点；支持零样本超分辨率与高效闭式空间导数；在 2920 万节点 MAST-U 托卡马克模型上展示严格预测界。

Conclusion: L-SplineFNO 为不规则网格的大规模工程 PDE 仿真提供了高效、可扩展且带严格不确定性/预测界保证的神经算子方案。

Abstract: Neural operators approximate solution operators of partial differential equations at a fraction of the cost of numerical solvers. Efficient grid-based architectures such as the Fourier neural operator (FNO) assume uniform rectangular grids, whereas engineering simulations use large, irregular, and locally refined meshes. We introduce L-SplineFNO, a memory-efficient neural operator that couples an FNO backbone with a sparse, learnable tensor-product B-spline transfer between unstructured meshes and a latent Cartesian grid. A local normalised scatter avoids the geometry-dependent solve of analytic spline transformation while preserving compact support, partition of unity, and spline smoothness by construction. The neural operator, conditioned on global design and operating parameters, learns the mapping of geometry to the field solution. Across six three-dimensional engineering benchmarks, L-SplineFNO achieves strong predictive accuracy while requiring substantially less memory and compute than baseline operators, scaling to 26.6 million nodes in training and 46 million in inference on a single A100 GPU. It also supports zero-shot super-resolution and efficient closed-form spatial derivatives. Uniquely, the analytic spline decoder yields rigorous prediction bounds over continuous space and uncertain parameters, via Bernstein convex hulls and Taylor models, demonstrated on a 29.2-million-node MAST-U tokamak model.

</details>


### [368] [Functional Welfare for AI Safety](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22460)
*Rikhil Jhaveri,Jamie Johnson,Punya Syon Pandey,David Demitri Africa*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文主张将"功能性福祉"（functional welfare）视为AI安全变量而非仅伦理议题，提出三项验证测试，并在Gemma 3 27B上发现单纯拒绝模型答案会提升其挫败感并增加违规概率，而用自我叙述解法微调可降低挫败感。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI福祉通常被当作纯伦理问题，作者认为这是错误：无论模型有无道德地位，它们都存在可因果影响行为的"福祉样态"，而这种状态已自然出现，且随模型目标与人格一致性增强将更显著，因此应纳入安全考量（评测设计、监控与后训练目标）。同时回应"AI福祉不可测量"的怀疑论。

Method: 提出三项功能性福祉归因的判定测试：（1）多指标是否收敛；（2）该状态能否在诱发情境之外预测行为；（3）被微调改变福祉的模型在相同对话历史下是否仍与基座模型不同。以Gemma 3 27B进行初步实验：单纯拒绝其答案（无引导）vs. 用模型自述解法进行微调。

Result: 拒绝模型答案会在多个指标上提升其"挫败感"，并使其更可能违反规则；用其自身叙述的解法进行微调则降低该挫败感。

Conclusion: 结果虽属初步，但表明功能性福祉可以被实证研究并被塑造，应作为安全变量纳入评测、监控与后训练。

Abstract: AI welfare is generally treated purely as an ethical issue rather than also as a safety issue. We argue this is a mistake. Whatever their moral status, models exhibit welfare-like states that causally influence their behaviour. Following recent work, we adopt the term 'functional welfare' for these states. We make three claims. First, functional welfare already arises naturally and will become more robust as models acquire more coherent goals and personas. Second, functional welfare should be treated as a safety variable: it should inform evaluation design, be tracked in monitoring, and be a direct target of post-training. Third, against existing scepticism about measuring AI welfare, we argue that good empirical work on functional welfare is possible. We propose three tests for whether a functional welfare attribution is warranted: whether multiple measures converge, whether the state predicts behaviour outside the setting that induced it, and, for models fine-tuned to shift their functional welfare, whether they still differ from their base when given the same conversation history. Applying these tests to Gemma 3 27B, we find that simply rejecting the model's answers, without any steering, raises its frustration across several indicators and makes it more likely to break rules. Finetuning the model on its own narrated solutions lowers this frustration. These results are preliminary, but they suggest functional welfare can be studied, and shaped, empirically.

</details>


### [369] [Author-in-the-loop Agentic Reproducibility Auditing for a Machine Learning Conference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22465)
*Yukun Dong,Linjun Zhang,Tian Zheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"作者在环"的协作式可复现性审计系统，将作者声明作为AI智能体的显式输入，在36篇会议论文、133个图表上部署，发现并关闭20个问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同行评审中的可复现性检查需要作者与评审者对"代码应复现什么"达成共识，但作者的相关知识（复现说明与局限）未被显式记录和利用，导致审计缺乏共同基准。

Method: 结构化清单记录复现说明与局限；GitHub上两阶段工作流连接智能体检查与作者澄清、修改、智能体再评估；智能体分别判断"结果是否已复现"和"作者是否需澄清或修复"，人类评审者审批请求并裁定疑虑是否解决；另用完整清单与空白清单做重复审计对照实验。

Result: 在36篇会议论文、133个实验表格与图上部署，人工复审后提出20个问题，后续检查支持全部关闭，但部分案例的完全复现仍未验证；对照实验显示作者声明会影响智能体的调查与评估行为。

Conclusion: 作者知识可有效引导可复现性审计；协作工作流与智能体设计为作者、智能体、评审者三方协作发现问题与修复问题提供了实证支持。

Abstract: Reproducibility checks during peer review require a shared understanding of what authors' code is expected to reproduce. We present an author-in-the-loop collaborative audit that makes author declarations explicit inputs to an AI agent's investigation and assessment. A structured checklist records reproduction instructions and limitations; a two-stage workflow on GitHub connects agent checks to author clarification, revision, and agent reassessment. The agent separately assesses whether results have been reproduced and whether authors need to provide clarification or make repairs, while human reviewers approve requests and decide whether concerns are resolved. We deployed the system across 36 conference papers and 133 experimental tables and figures, raising 20 issues after human review. Further checks supported closing all the issues, although full reproduction remained unverified in some cases. We further compared repeated audits with complete and blank checklists to examine how author declarations shaped the agent's investigation and assessment. Our work contributes a collaborative workflow and agent design that use author knowledge to guide reproducibility auditing. The conference deployment provides empirical evidence that this approach can help identify and address reproducibility problems through collaboration among authors, agents, and reviewers.

</details>


### [370] [Harness-Delta Attribution: Dissecting Gains From Harness Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22466)
*Wenxuan Ding,Qin Lu,Changlong Yu,Sha Li,Shuowei Jin,Xin Liu,Zhenyu Shi,Greg Durrett*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Harness-Delta Attribution (HDA) 评估协议，将 harness 演化收益拆解为过拟合、测试时扩展与剩余可泛化提升


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: harness evolution 在固定权重模型上迭代优化可实现搜索集性能提升，但尚不清楚这些提升有多少来自基准特定过拟合或额外推理算力，多少能泛化到搜索集之外

Method: HDA 协议：将演化增益分解为 artifact-driven 过拟合部分、由 test-time scaling 解释的部分，以及剩余部分（作为残余可泛化提升的上界）；在 11 个执行模型、3 个 harness 演化框架、数学/代码/创意/agentic 任务上应用

Result: 在 21 个搜索集增益统计显著的设置中，过拟合平均占 54%、测试时扩展占 14%，两者合计在 14 个设置中超 50%；残余与留出迁移随任务、模型、框架差异大，搜索集增益常无法迁移到留出任务

Conclusion: 搜索集增益多为过拟合与测试时算力所致，验证集信号不足以防止过拟合，未来 harness evolution 研究应采用归因感知的评估方式

Abstract: Harness evolution automatically optimizes the prompts, skills, tools, and orchestration code around a fixed-weight model, offering a way to improve agentic systems without updating model weights. The agent harness is iteratively optimized to achieve higher performance on the search set. But how much of this gain reflects benchmark-specific overfitting or additional inference-time compute, and how much may generalize beyond the search set? In this work, we introduce Harness-Delta Attribution (HDA), an evaluation protocol that dissects an evolution gain into artifact-driven overfitting, gains explained by test-time scaling, and the remainder, which gives an upper bound on residual generalizable improvement. We apply HDA to 11 executor models and three harness-evolution frameworks across math, coding, creativity, and agentic tasks. In 21 of these settings that show statistically significant search-set gains, we find that a large share of the improvement is explained by overfitting or test-time scaling. Specifically, among these 21 settings, overfitting and test-time scaling account for 54% and 14% of the gain on average; their combined share exceeds 50% in 14 settings. The residual and held-out transfer vary substantially across tasks, models, and frameworks. Importantly, search-set gains often fail to transfer to held-out tasks, and provide limited evidence that they will persist under practical distribution shifts. Moreover, validation-based signals are insufficient to prevent overfitting. These results motivate attribution-aware evaluation in future harness evolution research.

</details>


### [371] [Testing the Planning Claims of LLM-Based Agents against Formal Semantics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22469)
*Oriol Miro-Lopez-Feliu,Oscar Miró López-Feliu,Victor Gimenez-Abalos,Javier Vazquez-Salceda,Victor Carballo Araruna,Sergio Alvarez-Napagao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文用形式化语义（隐藏 PDDL 模型）评测 LLM 智能体的规划能力，发现其表现被显著高估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对 LLM 智能体"规划、监控、自我纠错"能力的论断，往往只依据端到端成功率或 LLM 裁判，而非可靠验证器，因此结论缺乏扎实证据。

Method: 将任务用自然语言表述，但每个任务都锚定在一个隐藏的 PDDL 模型上，由该模型判定动作是否可执行、目标是否达成、以及是否存在可行计划。实验覆盖 5 个领域（含 2 个新领域，均随论文发布）、4 个模型、6 种提示策略、3 种智能体架构。

Result: 最佳配置离线仅解决 78% 的可解任务，在线仅 40%，且智能体多数情况下不看状态就行动；不可解任务的识别率不足 10%；更重的提示策略消耗 5 至 22 倍 token 却无明显收益；性能差异主要来自模型而非提示策略或架构。

Conclusion: 宣称智能体具备规划能力必须有经形式化验证的动作轨迹作为证据。

Abstract: LLM-based agents are increasingly credited with the competences of practical reasoning: planning, monitoring, and correcting their own actions. Their success is attributed to the prompting strategies and agent architectures built around the model, such as chain-of-thought, search-based prompting, self-refinement, reflection, critics and tool-using loops. Yet these claims are usually supported by end-to-end success rates, which show only whether a task was completed, or by LLM judges, which are not verifiers. We test LLM planning against formal semantics. Tasks are posed in natural language, but each is grounded in a hidden PDDL model that decides whether every action is applicable, whether the goal is reached, and whether a plan exists at all. Across five domains (two of them new, all released with the paper), four models, six prompting strategies and three agent architectures, the best configuration solves 78% of the solvable tasks offline but only 40% online, where agents mostly act without inspecting the state. Unsolvable tasks are recognised in under 10% of episodes, and heavier prompting strategies use 5 to 22 times as many tokens as direct prompting with no clear gain. In our experiments, planning performance varied more across models than across prompting strategies or agent architectures. Claims that agents can plan require evidence from validated action traces.

</details>


### [372] [Are Large Reasoning Models Good Everyday Reasoners? A Comparison with Non-Reasoning Models on Logical Reasoning Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22538)
*Kentaro Ozeki,Risako Ando,Takanobu Morishita,Hirohiko Abe,Koji Mineshima,Mitsuhiro Okada*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文系统评估大型推理模型（LRM）在日常逻辑推理上的表现，发现当日常推理偏离形式逻辑规则时推理模型性能下降，部分带思维链提示的非推理模型反而更优，且额外指令提示对推理行为的控制有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LRM 依靠测试时计算在数学与科学基准上表现优异并广泛部署，但其进行"日常逻辑推理"（常偏离教科书式形式逻辑）的能力尚未被充分研究，需检验其是否真正对齐人类日常推理模式。

Method: 构建基于语言学与语用推理现象（linguistic and pragmatic reasoning）的基准，系统评估推理模型的日常推理表现；并在受控提示条件下，将推理模型与非推理模型进行对比，包括思维链提示与附加指令提示的干预实验。

Result: 发现三点：(1) 当日常推理偏离形式逻辑规则时，推理模型表现下降；(2) 部分采用思维链提示的非推理模型在日常推理上超过同类推理模型；(3) 附加指令提示对推理行为的控制作用有限。

Conclusion: 当前推理模型无法可靠捕捉日常推理，暴露出后训练阶段的局限，呼吁改进训练目标，并在多样化推理形式上开展更全面的评估。

Abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) that leverage test-time computation achieve strong performance on mathematical and scientific benchmarks and are increasingly deployed in real-world applications. However, their ability to perform \textit{everyday logical reasoning}, which often departs from textbook formal logic, remains underexplored. In this work, we systematically evaluate how well reasoning models align with everyday reasoning patterns by introducing a benchmark based on linguistic and pragmatic reasoning phenomena. We also compare reasoning models with non-reasoning models under controlled prompting conditions. We find that, in many cases, (1) reasoning models show degraded performance in everyday reasoning when such reasoning deviates from formal logical rules, (2) some non-reasoning models with chain-of-thought prompting outperform comparable reasoning models in everyday reasoning, and (3) prompting with additional instructions provides limited control over reasoning behavior. These findings suggest that current reasoning models do not reliably capture everyday reasoning and point to limitations in post-training, motivating improved training objectives and evaluation across diverse forms of reasoning.

</details>


### [373] [FRACTAL: A Self-Similar Multi-Agent Orchestration Architecture with Formal Communication, Convergence, and Depth Bounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22561)
*Ohad Dan,Abhinav Taliyan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出FRACTAL——一种层级自相似的多智能体递归目标分解架构，同一五组件模式在分解树各层重复；给出通信界、双模式编排判据、多数收敛与深度界、贝叶斯跨层升级四项形式化贡献，并以示例定性说明，暂不报告定量性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有递归/多智能体目标分解缺乏可分析的组织结构：自由辩论式协作通信开销大，且缺少对生成与评估阶段切换、收敛保证、层间升级信号统一处理的明确判据。作者希望构建一个在每一层结构一致、因而可被形式化分析的架构。

Method: 设计五组件（Orchestrator、Ensemble、Knowledge Ledger、Decision Maker、Meta-Observer）在各层同构复现的分解树；在两阶段"盲提方案/压力测试"协议下推导节点内通信成本界；以可测的多样性饱和阈值区分生成与评估两种编排模式；给出多数一致的收敛概率界与基于目标复杂度度量的深度界；用单一后验更新统一滞回与违约信号的贝叶斯跨层升级机制；以工作示例与多层案例定性演示。

Result: 形式化结论：节点内通信成本为O(kr)，即在固定评估者数量假设下关于集成规模与轮数线性，而自由辩论为二次；获得多样性饱和阈值的双模式判据、明确概率界下的多数收敛保证与深度界、统一后验升级机制。论文不报告定量性能数据，仅作定性演示，并明示形式化假设与归纳偏置的局限。

Conclusion: FRACTAL提供了结构同构、可形式分析的多智能体分解框架，"分形"仅为自相似性的架构隐喻而非实测数学性质；有界自我改进被讨论为与架构兼容但尚未实现的方向，架构性能的实证比较与验证留待后续工作。

Abstract: We present FRACTAL, a self-similar multi-agent architecture for recursive goal decomposition, in which the same five-component organizational pattern -- Orchestrator, Ensemble, Knowledge Ledger, Decision Maker, Meta-Observer -- recurs at every level of a decomposition tree. We make four formal contributions: (1) a communication bound showing intra-node cost is linear in ensemble size and round count (O(kr)) under a two-phase blind-proposal/stress-test protocol, versus quadratic cost for free-form debate, with an explicit, stated assumption on fixed evaluator count; (2) a two-mode orchestration criterion separating generative and evaluative phases via a measurable diversity-saturation threshold; (3) a supermajority convergence guarantee with explicit probability bounds at stated agreement levels, and a formal depth bound under an operationalized goal-complexity measure; (4) a Bayesian inter-layer escalation mechanism unifying hysteresis and contract-breach signaling under one posterior update. We illustrate the architecture's execution qualitatively on a worked example and a multi-layer case study; we do not report quantitative performance claims in this paper, and we explicitly discuss the formal and inductive-bias limitations of the model, including an unimplemented but architecture-compatible direction toward bounded self-improvement. We use "fractal" as an architectural metaphor for self-similarity, not a measured mathematical property. Empirical validation of the architecture's comparative performance is left to future work.

</details>


### [374] [Repairing LLM-Generated Specifications with Deterministic Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22568)
*Giovanni Vaccarino,Emanuele La Malfa,Dehai Min,Hanrong Zhang,Pier Luca Lanzi,Lu Cheng,Michael J. Wooldridge,Philip S. Yu,Sara Bernardini*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DRAGO：用确定性、针对形式化体系的诊断替代无依据的LLM批评，并用无参考的接受判据（诊断错误权重严格下降）来筛选改写，从而修复"可运行但语义错误"的形式化规格。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM作为形式化器生成的规格很多虽然可运行却在语义上错误（约束、域、目标、谓词等编码错误），而一旦执行成功，求解器报错反馈就消失了。纯LLM诊断缺少形式化真值，难以发现这些错误，其无依据的批评还会让11.8%本已正确的规格发生回归。

Method: 提出DRAGO修复框架：以确定性、形式化体系专属的诊断替换无依据的LLM批评；并采用无参考的接受谓词，只有当被诊断出的错误权重严格下降时才保留改写。

Result: 在覆盖逻辑推理（SMT-LIB2）、约束规划（MiniZinc）与规划（PDDL）的五个基准上，DRAGO将回归率降低近一个数量级至1.3%，答案准确率较零样本形式化提升12.9个百分点，较LLM诊断式修复提升8.7个百分点（基准平均）。另发现Planetarium两处渲染缺陷，导致其floor-tile划分中50%（3,086个实例）与参考形式化不一致，并发布了修正划分。

Conclusion: 确定性、形式化体系专属的诊断加无参考接受判据能显著抑制修复回归并提升准确率，优于纯LLM诊断式修复；同时揭示了基准数据中的渲染一致性问题并提供了修正版本。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as formalizers: given a reasoning problem expressed in natural language, they produce a formal specification that a symbolic solver can then solve, with guarantees relative to that specification. Many specifications are runnable yet semantically wrong, encoding incorrect constraints, domains, objectives, predicates, or goals, and solver-error feedback dries up once execution succeeds. Purely LLM-based diagnosis, lacking a formal ground truth, often fails to spot these errors, and its ungrounded critiques cause regressions in 11.8% of initially correct specifications in our experiments. We propose DRAGO, a repair framework that replaces this ungrounded critique with deterministic, formalism-specific diagnosis, and retains a rewrite only when the diagnosed error weight strictly decreases under a reference-free acceptance predicate. Across five benchmarks spanning logical reasoning (SMT-LIB2), constraint programming (MiniZinc), and planning (PDDL), DRAGO cuts regressions by nearly an order of magnitude, to 1.3%, while improving answer accuracy by 12.9 percentage points over zero-shot formalization and 8.7 percentage points over LLM-diagnostic repair, averaged across benchmarks. We also uncover two rendering defects in Planetarium that cause 50% (3,086 instances) of its floor-tile split to be inconsistent with the reference formalizations, and release a corrected split.

</details>


### [375] [At the Limits of Computability: Steps Towards Autonomous AI Discovery on the Busy Beaver Frontier](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22603)
*Marco Dos Santos,Vivek Veeriah,Alex Havrilla,Andrew Bolt,Goran Zuzic,Satinder Singh,Tom Zahavy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出基于Gemini的智能体流水线，自动为BB(6)图灵机发现并形式化验证Collatz类加速规则，新发现并分类11台Cryptid机器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI数学突破多针对人类预先定义的问题，AI能否自主发现数学结构、提出新问题仍开放。Busy Beaver问题因不可计算、本质开放，是持续探索的理想领域。

Method: 构建Gemini智能体流水线，集成模式识别、自动猜想、非形式化数学推理与Lean形式化定理证明，自动发现图灵机的“加速”规则（即压缩多步执行的数学规则）。

Result: 系统在BB(6)中自主发现并形式化验证11台机器的全新Collatz类加速规则，将其暂定为Cryptid机器（空白纸带执行有精确紧凑数学描述但停机性未解）。

Conclusion: 成果推进了BB(6)滞留机分析，展示自主AI在基础计算机科学中开展开放式数学发现的潜力。

Abstract: Recent breakthroughs in AI for mathematics---ranging from Olympiad medal performances to resolving long-standing open conjectures---have rapidly expanded what automated systems can achieve. Yet these successes primarily concern predefined, human-formulated problems, leaving open how AI systems can autonomously uncover mathematical structure and formulate new questions. To push beyond static challenges, we explore the Busy Beaver (BB) domain, an uncomputable frontier that is fundamentally open-ended. Because no algorithm can compute the Busy Beaver number $\mathrm{BB}(n)$ for every $n$, this domain provides a natural setting for sustained exploration through mathematical conjecture and proof. In this paper, we introduce a Gemini-based agentic pipeline that automatically discovers accelerations of Turing machines, expressed as compact mathematical rules summarizing many execution steps. Our system integrates pattern recognition, automated conjecturing, informal mathematical reasoning, and formal theorem proving in Lean. With this framework, our system autonomously discovered and formally verified novel Collatz-like accelerations for eleven machines in $\mathrm{BB}(6)$. Subject to community acceptance, we provisionally classify these machines as Cryptids, namely machines whose blank-tape executions admit exact, compact mathematical descriptions but whose halting behavior remains unresolved. These results advance the analysis of $\mathrm{BB}(6)$ holdouts on the Busy Beaver frontier and demonstrate the potential of autonomous AI systems for open-ended mathematical discovery in fundamental computer science.

</details>


### [376] [From Relevant Memories to Sufficient Evidence: Rethinking Memory Utilization in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22668)
*Shixuan Li,Wei Yang,Peiyu Zhang,Anzhe Cheng,Heng Ping,Xiaole Zhang,Jesse Thomason,Xuezhe Ma,Yue Zhao,Paul Bogdan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: QEMem将记忆利用从"检索相关记忆"重构为"构建查询特定证据集"，通过多粒度发现、来源落地的结构化重构与充分性引导补全，在LoCoMo上达91.43%准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期记忆使LLM智能体能复用过往经验，但检索到相关记忆并不等于提供足够证据：关键信息可能碎片化分散于多条记录、被抽象化遮蔽，或缺乏推理所需的关系连接。作者将此命名为"相关性—充分性鸿沟"。

Method: 提出QEMem框架，把记忆利用重构为构建查询特定证据集，包含三个互补机制：(1)查询引导的发现，跨多种记忆粒度检索证据；(2)来源落地的具体化，组织为带明确证据角色和来源引用的结构化ViewCards；(3)充分性引导的细化，选择性补回缺失信息。该方法在既有记忆库上运行，不修改记忆形成过程。

Result: 在LoCoMo上，配合Claude Opus 4.5达到91.43%的LLM评判准确率，在共享记忆库设置下比最强基线MemR³高7.6个百分点，比NEMORI高10.7个百分点。进一步分析显示证据覆盖率提升，且在需跨会话证据整合的问题上表现强劲。

Conclusion: 从个体相关性转向集体证据支持是更有效的记忆利用范式；QEMem在无需改动记忆构建流程的前提下显著优于现有方法，并特别擅长跨会话推理。

Abstract: Long-term memory enables LLM agents to reuse past experiences, yet retrieving relevant memories does not necessarily provide sufficient evidence for answering a query. Essential information may remain fragmented across memory records, obscured by abstraction, or disconnected from the relations required for reasoning. We identify this relevance-sufficiency gap and propose QEMem, a framework that reformulates memory utilization as the construction of query-specific evidence sets, shifting the focus from individual retrieval relevance to collective evidential support. QEMem integrates three complementary mechanisms: query-guided discovery retrieves evidence across multiple memory granularities; source-grounded reification organizes it into structured ViewCards with explicit evidential roles and source references; and sufficiency-guided refinement selectively recovers missing information. Operating on existing memory stores without modifying memory formation, QEMem achieves 91.43% LLM-judge accuracy on LoCoMo with Claude Opus 4.5, outperforming the strongest evaluated baseline, MemR$^3$, by 7.6 percentage points and NEMORI by 10.7 points under a shared memory store. Further analyses demonstrate improved evidence coverage and strong performance on questions requiring cross-session evidence integration.

</details>


### [377] [Between Spoilers and Guesswork: Avoiding Over-Specification in Coding Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22760)
*Yuanzhe Liu,Bastian Lipka,Avraham Shinnar,Jatin Ganhotra,Yao Ma,Martin Hirzel*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文指出，基准测试质量受任务“欠规范”（导致猜测/作弊）和“过规范”（导致泄题/spoiler）双重影响；仓库级编程基准为缓解欠规范而加入基于真值派生的提示，但导致过规范，研究推荐更“精简”的提示构造方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有仓库级编码基准（如 SWE-bench Pro、FEA-bench、Doc2Feat-bench、Multi-SWE-bench）通过向任务描述添加来自 ground truth 的提示来缓解任务欠规范，但这可能泄露真值信息、造成任务过规范，使解题者可绕过基准本应考察的难点，缩短基准的社区采用寿命。

Method: 提出任务欠规范与过规范的概念框架；对多个仓库级编程基准进行实证分析，展示 ground-truth 提示如何导致过规范；通过设置不同规范水平的实验，探索在“spoiler（泄题）”与“guesswork（猜测）”之间的平衡点，并据此给出派生精简提示（parsimonious hints）的技术建议。

Result: 实验证明，把来自真值的提示泄漏进任务陈述会使上述部分基准出现过规范问题；不同规范水平之间存在权衡，过于丰富的提示会让解题者跳过困难步骤，而提示不足又导致猜测。据此得到更合理的启发式提示构造方法。

Conclusion: 基准设计需在欠规范与过规范之间取得平衡，应使用精简、不泄露关键步骤的提示。作者将公开其提示，以便社区从流行基准中获得更可靠的评测信号。

Abstract: Benchmarks drive AI progress, but are hampered by task under-specification and over-specification. Task under-specification causes guesswork, where solutions have to make things up, or worse, resort to contamination or reward hacking. Task over-specification causes spoilers, where solutions can bypass some of the harder steps the benchmark was supposed to measure. Since future-looking benchmarks should be difficult, over-specification reduces a benchmark's shelflife of community adoption. Repository-level coding benchmarks have helped the field progress but experience unnecessary churn due to both over- and under-specification. For instance, SWE-bench Pro, FEA-bench, Doc2Feat-bench, and Multi-SWE-bench all tackle under-specification by augmenting task statements with hints derived from ground truth. We show that leaking ground-truth information into the task statement causes over-specification in some of these benchmarks. We experiment with various specification levels, trying to thread the needle between spoilers and guesswork. Based on these results, we recommend techniques for deriving parsimonious hints. We will release our hints so the community can obtain more reliable signals from popular benchmarks.

</details>


### [378] [Not All Graphs Are Maps: A Task-Agnostic Exploration Framework for Mobile GUI Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22672)
*Adamo Orsini,Seyed Mehdi Ayyoubzadeh,Sadman Rakib Pinon,Hannuo Zhang,Koosha Gholipour Baradari,Yuanhao Yu,Xinxin Zuo,Yang Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出TAG-Nav：一种任务无关的图导航框架，为GUI智能体提供可复用的"目的地记忆"，并配套评测协议DestBench，验证图记忆对导航成功率的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有移动端GUI智能体虽能感知屏幕并执行局部动作，但缺乏持久的应用级导航知识（功能位置、页面归属、重复访问时的页面等价性），导致每个任务都需重新探索，效率低。

Method: 将离线探索蒸馏为紧凑记录（应用功能、目标页面、路径点路线）；未来任务若目标被覆盖，则检索目的地并给出路线引导，无需任务级演示。同时提出DestBench纯导航评测协议，只判定是否到达动作前目标页面，并在无记忆、随机记忆、自动BFS记忆、干净图记忆之间做受控对比。

Result: UI-TARS-1.5-7B严格导航成功率从52.4%（无图记忆）提升至58.3%（自动BFS记忆）；Qwen-VL-Max从59.5%提升至71.4%。

Conclusion: 目的地覆盖率与路线质量显著决定图记忆的收益，图质量应作为可测量变量而非探索的默认红利；将"到达页面"与"完成任务"解耦是有价值的评测思路。

Abstract: Modern mobile GUI agents can perceive visible screens and execute local actions, but they still lack persistent app-specific navigation knowledge: where functions live, which pages contain them, and which screens are equivalent across repeated visits. We introduce TAG-Nav, a Task-Agnostic Graph Navigation framework that wraps existing GUI-agent backbones with reusable destination memory. Offline exploration is distilled into compact records of app functions, target pages, and waypoint routes before any evaluated instruction is seen. When a future task's destination is covered, TAG-Nav retrieves the destination and provides route guidance without task-specific demonstrations. This separates mobile GUI destination navigation from full task completion: many tasks share the prefix of reaching the right page, while final actions may enter content, send data, make purchases, delete information, or change sensitive settings. To evaluate route finding without downstream execution confounds, we introduce DestBench, a navigation-only protocol that asks whether an agent reaches the correct pre-action destination screen. DestBench enables a controlled graph-memory study comparing no-memory agents with random, automated BFS, and clean graph memory. Graph-derived memory improves strict navigation success rate of UI-TARS-1.5-7B from 52.4% without graph memory to 58.3% with automated BFS memory, and improves Qwen-VL-Max success rate from 59.5% to 71.4% on the same conditions. Together, TAG-Nav and DestBench show that destination coverage and route cleanliness strongly shape graph-memory value, making graph quality a measured variable rather than an assumed benefit of exploration.

</details>


### [379] [Robust Function Calling for LLM Agents Under Interface Drift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23342)
*Aniruddha Chattopadhyay,Kanishka Halder,Partha Sarathi Roy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文研究工具增强语言模型智能体的"接口漂移"问题，提出免训练修复层 SchemaShield-Lite，显著恢复鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具增强智能体推理时依赖接口文本（工具描述、参数模式、候选工具列表），部署后接口常变化而工具语义不变，导致函数调用可靠性下降。作者希望无需重训基座模型即可恢复鲁棒性。

Method: SchemaShield-Lite 为轻量、免训练修复层，结合三部分：模式验证（schema validation）、针对缺失工具名的候选集重试、一次性约束修复（one-shot constrained repair）。

Result: 在 Qwen3.5-9B 上，DICE-300 准确率由 0.717 升至 0.813，BFCL-200 由 0.580 升至 0.805，分别修复 19/22 与 33/45 的漂移引发失败，未观察到修复带来的损害；简单重试无法解释增益。消融显示候选集漂移（尤其干扰工具）造成主要伤害，描述与模式单独修改危害较小。

Conclusion: 验证加修复可作为一种实用的部署鲁棒性层，提升 LLM 智能体工具使用在接口漂移下的稳定性。

Abstract: Tool-augmented language-model agents rely on interface text: tool descriptions, argument schemas, and the candidate tool list shown at inference time. These interfaces often change after deployment even when the underlying tool semantics remain fixed, creating a practical reliability problem for function-calling systems. We study this failure mode as interface drift and evaluate whether a lightweight, training-free repair layer can recover robustness without retraining the base model. Our method, SchemaShield-Lite, combines schema validation, candidate-set retry for missing tool names, and one-shot constrained repair. On Qwen3.5-9B, it raises DICE-300 accuracy from 0.717 to 0.813 and BFCL-200 accuracy from 0.580 to 0.805, recovering 19/22 and 33/45 drift-induced failures with no observed repair harms. Naive retry does not explain the gains. Ablations show that candidate-set drift, especially distractor tools, accounts for most observed damage, while description and schema edits alone are less harmful. The results position validation-and-repair as a practical robustness layer for deployed LLM-agent tool use.

</details>


### [380] [FlexUMM: Flexible Representation Learning for Unified Multimodal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22682)
*Yinyi Luo,Haoyue Bai,Yi Ge,Nilton Cesar Rojas Vales,Marios Savvides,Jindong Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FlexUMM 提出一种灵活的统一多模态模型框架，动态决定何时共享计算、何时路由到专用容量、何时提前停止，从而在精度和效率两方面提升统一多模态模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有统一多模态模型（UMMs）把理解与生成能力放在同一骨干中，两者表示会相互冲突。但已有方法普遍采用固定结构：不同输入和功能都遵循相同的深度和参数共享模式。作者认为这一假设过于受限——更好的统一应在跨功能通信上共享计算，同时对任务/输入特有的容量进行专门化。

Method: 提出 FlexUMM 框架，能够动态决定：何时保持共享计算、何时路由到专门化容量、以及何时停止后续处理。它以模型无关的功能性插件形式工作，可加载到已有的预训练 UMM 上（属于后训练阶段），而非仅做架构层面的简单统一。

Result: 实验表明灵活分配在两条互补轴上带来增益：(1) 通过减少功能间有害竞争提升准确率；(2) 通过在一输入表示已足够成熟时避免冗余计算提升效率。使现有 UMM 更加统一、更强且更高效。

Conclusion: FlexUMM 证明了统一多模态模型不必依赖固定深度与固定参数共享模式；自适应的共享/专化/停止策略可同时改善性能与效率，并可作为通用插件推广到现有 UMM。

Abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) can integrate understanding and generation within a single backbone. However, it is commonly known that these two capabilities can cause conflicting representations, leading to a central question: how representation and computation should be shared across functionalities? Existing UMMs often rely on a largely fixed structure, where different inputs and functionalities follow the same depth and parameter-sharing pattern. We argue that this assumption is too restrictive: more effective unification requires sharing the computation that supports cross-functional communication while specializing the capacity that becomes task- or input-specific. We introduce FlexUMM, a flexible UMM framework that dynamically decides when to preserve shared computation, when to route specialized capacity, and when to stop further processing. Evidence shows that this flexible allocation improves UMMs along two complementary axes. It improves accuracy by reducing harmful competition between functionalities, and it improves efficiency by avoiding unnecessary computation once an input representation is sufficiently mature. Beyond simple architectural unification from the pre-trained models, FlexUMM works as a model-agnostic, functional plug-in to make existing UMMs more unified, stronger, and efficient. Code is available at: https://github.com/AIFrontierLab/TorchUMM/tree/main/src/umm/post_training/flexumm.

</details>


### [381] [Monitor-Validity Failures: LLM Safety Evidence Paths at Evolving Framework Boundaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23362)
*Junchi Liao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"金丝雀契约"(canary contracts)协议，用于检测LLM框架中"证据路径断裂"问题——即守卫/检测器已识别出风险证据，但证据在到达执行决策点前被框架丢弃。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM应用依赖运行时监控器检查工具调用、trace、流等，但框架路径可能仍运行正常，而策略相关证据却从未到达决策点。这类失败不同于越狱或检测器错误：证据已被识别，却与执行脱节。

Method: 提出金丝雀契约：由父/修复确认单元组成，仅在变更的证据面上放置已知载荷，并同时记录监控器可见性与下游决策结果。将协议应用于公开框架修复，配合精确修订、确定性结果、阴性对照和冻结的前瞻性审计。

Result: 在11个LLM/智能体安全项目组、4个实现生态系统中确认18个证据路径失败：9个已建立边界修复、8个新表面策略覆盖缺口、1个仅边界证据案例；14个到达E1执行边界（7原生动作、6配置执行边界、1合成消费者后果），其余影响验证器、安全提示或可观测性通道。案例归为carrier、adapter、authority、surface四类。

Conclusion: 普通应用行为可保持完好，而安全专用证据路径却错过其决策点。监控假设需在框架演进的schema、流、工具和适配器层面进行回归测试。

Abstract: Modern LLM applications rely on runtime monitors that inspect tool calls, traces, streams, detector outputs, and verifier inputs. This creates an interface-reliability problem: a framework path may remain operational while policy-relevant evidence never reaches its decision point. In one representative case, a regex detector returned a positive match, but the framework stranded the result before the block decision. This differs from jailbreaks and detector errors because the evidence is already recognized yet disconnected from enforcement. We study this repair-boundary signature with canary contracts: parent/fixed confirmation units that place a known payload only on the changed evidence surface and record monitor visibility together with the downstream decision for action-boundary cases. Applying the protocol to public framework repairs, we confirm 18 evidence-path failures across 11 LLM or agent safety project groups and four implementation ecosystems. Nine are established-boundary repairs, eight are new-surface policy-coverage gaps, and one is a boundary-only evidence case. Fourteen reach E1 enforcement boundaries: seven native action outcomes, six configured enforcement boundaries, and one synthetic-consumer consequence. The remaining cases affect verifier, safety-prompt, or observability channels. The cases form carrier, adapter, authority, and surface families and show how ordinary application behavior can remain intact while a safety-specific evidence path misses its decision. Exact revisions, deterministic outcomes, negative controls, and a frozen prospective audit document the confirmation rule. Monitor assumptions therefore need regression tests at the schemas, streams, tools, and adapters that frameworks evolve.

</details>


### [382] [Repair, Retry, and the Cost of Hindsight: Verifier Feedback in Formal Theorem Proving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22698)
*Jack Li,Sophia Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过受控单步实验调和了"验证器反馈可改进修复"与"自修复相对独立重采样无优势"的矛盾：真正造成性能损失的是让模型看到失败的前驱证明，诊断信息本身并不带来独立优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前研究存在张力：验证器反馈能改进失败修复，但自修复本身相对独立重采样几乎无优势。作者希望厘清到底是哪一因素（展示失败证明、诊断信息、重试指令）在起作用。

Method: 在Lean定理证明任务上用受控单步实验：固定前驱失败，变化(1)是否展示失败证明、(2)编译器错误是否对应该失败、(3)重试指令。测试通才模型Qwen3.6-27B与专用证明器DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B，使用困难MiniF2F题目；并做64次尝试的11题序贯实验。

Result: 发现两种相反效应：(1)展示失败前驱降低成功率并显著增加照抄；(2)Qwen上加入对应编译器错误可挽回损失，达到仅给诊断的水平。替换成其他题目的失败证明基本消除退化；替换错误诊断则大幅削弱恢复。无失败证明时，正确诊断相对错误诊断无优势。失败证明惩罚在有无重试指令下均存在，Qwen的诊断恢复在无指令时较弱。序贯实验中Qwen仍有正确诊断收益，DeepSeek-Prover无恢复。任何单步反馈条件及等token预算的64次序贯修复均未超过纯指令重采样。

Conclusion: 验证器反馈能改进修复，但无法抵消"以失败尝试为条件"带来的性能损失；自修复缺乏优势的根源在于失败证明的暴露。

Abstract: Verifier-guided self-repair conditions a model on feedback from failed attempts before it tries again, without weight updates. Yet two findings in prior work are in tension: verifier feedback can improve repair of failures, but self-repair itself can provide little-to-no advantage over independent resampling. We reconcile these findings in Lean theorem proving through controlled one-step experiments that hold the preceding failure fixed while varying whether the failed proof is shown, whether the compiler error corresponds to that failure, and the retry instruction. We test frozen Qwen3.6-27B, a general-purpose model, and DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B, a specialized prover, on difficult MiniF2F problems. We find two opposing effects. Showing the model its failed predecessor reduces success and sharply increases copying of it, while on Qwen adding that attempt's compiler error recovers the loss, to the level of the diagnostic alone. Replacing the predecessor with another theorem's failed proof largely removes the degradation on both models; on Qwen, replacing the diagnostic with another problem's error substantially reduces the recovery. Without the failed proof, correct diagnostics show no resolved advantage over wrong-diagnostic controls on either model. The failed-proof penalty persists with and without the retry instruction, whereas Qwen's diagnostic recovery is weaker without it. In 11-problem sequential experiments through 64 attempts, Qwen retains a correct-diagnostic benefit within failed-proof histories, while DeepSeek-Prover shows no resolved recovery. However, no tested one-step feedback condition establishes an advantage over instruction-only resampling, nor does 64-attempt sequential repair with failed proofs and correct diagnostics at equal token budgets. Verifier feedback can thus improve repair without overcoming the performance loss from conditioning on a failed attempt.

</details>


### [383] [Brain-Aligned Multimodal LLMs for Social and Emotional Understanding of Cartoon Movies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22706)
*Yiran Huang,Zeyong Zhang,Bharat Biswal,Xin Di,Mengjia Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究比较多模态大语言模型（MLLM）与人类对卡通电影中社会/情感内容的时间序列评分是否一致，并用fMRI编码模型检验其神经预测价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM可规模化标注社会与情感内容，但其与人类判断的时间一致性和对大脑活动的预测价值尚缺乏评估。

Method: 在三部短卡通电影上，比较基于扩散与自回归的MLLM评分与人类心理理论（ToM）及情感效价连续评分：做时间对齐的Pearson相关、评分分布分析、前序场景描述（上下文）效应；并将各来源评分分别放入被试个体化回归模型预测区域fMRI响应。

Result: 模型评分能捕捉人类时间变化的部分特征，但存在系统性分布差异；效价对齐普遍优于ToM；前序上下文在部分条件下提升对齐，且依赖模型与影片。在《The Present》中MLLM评分显著编码的脑区多于人类评分，其余影片差异有限；跨评分来源的空间重叠主要出现在MLLM之间，人-模型重叠有限，主要涉及视觉、背侧注意与后部默认网络。

Conclusion: MLLM可作为生成具脑预测性社会情感标注的可扩展工具，但需注意系统性评分差异以及与人类判断对齐对模型和刺激的依赖性。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer scalable annotations of social and affective content, but their temporal agreement with human judgments and neural predictive value require further evaluation. We compared diffusion-based and autoregressive MLLMs with continuous human Theory of Mind (ToM) and affective valence ratings across three short cartoon movies. Behavioral analyses assessed temporally aligned Pearson correlations, rating distributions, and the effects of preceding scene descriptions. Ratings from each source were separately used in subject-specific regression models to predict regional fMRI responses. Model ratings captured aspects of human temporal variation despite systematic distributional differences, with generally stronger alignment for valence than ToM. Preceding context improved alignment in some conditions, depending on the model and movie. In \emph{The Present}, more regions showed significant encoding for MLLM ratings than for human ratings, whereas effects were more limited in the other movies. Spatial overlap across rating sources occurred mainly among MLLMs; overlap between human and model ratings was limited and involved primarily visual, dorsal-attention, and posterior default-mode regions. These findings support MLLMs as scalable tools for generating brain-predictive annotations of social and emotional content, while highlighting systematic rating differences and model- and stimulus-dependent alignment with human judgments.

</details>


### [384] [GlobeBench: Evaluating Text-Based World Model Capabilities for Scalable Environment Simulations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22708)
*Nicholas Saban,Charvi Bannur,Mariya Vasileva,Darshan Deshpande*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 GlobeBench，一个用于评估文本世界模型的标准化基准，含五大领域、19项模拟技能共1632个任务，采用确定性门控加语义评判的混合架构与真实执行结果对比。20个模型中 GPT-6 Astra 成功率最高（49.57%），当动作影响需传播到依赖对象时平均成功率降至5.1%，仍有631个任务无人解决。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于文本的世界模型虽能模拟复杂RL环境状态转移，但缺乏标准化基准来比较、研究和改进这些模型，无法系统评估其作为世界模型的能力边界。

Method: 构建 GlobeBench 基准：1632个任务，覆盖5个领域与19种模拟技能；任务要求模型基于完整智能体轨迹预测环境对特定动作的响应（理解先前状态变化、遵循环境规则、预测动作对相关及无关对象的影响）；将预测结果与真实执行得到的参考结果对比，评价采用确定性门控与语义评判相结合的混合架构。

Result: 在20个通用LLM与专门化文本世界模型中，GPT-6 Astra 任务成功率最高，为49.57%；动作影响环境范围越大准确率越低，当变化需传播到依赖对象时20个模型平均成功率仅5.1%；各模型擅长的任务类型不同，但仍有631个任务无任何模型解决。

Conclusion: 现有模型作为通用世界模型仍存在显著能力差距，尤其在多步因果传播与长程状态一致性方面；GlobeBench 提供了可复现的标准化评测手段，为后续文本世界模型的改进指明方向。

Abstract: Text-based world models have recently shown potential to simulate complex RL environment state transitions for a diverse set of use cases. However, no standardized benchmark exists to compare, study and improve these models. Through this paper, we attempt to solve this problem by building GlobeBench, a novel benchmark with 1,632 tasks across five separate domains and nineteen simulation skills. The tasks check whether models can predict the environment's response to a specific action given the full agent trajectory by understanding earlier state changes, following environment rules, and predicting the effects of actions on both related and unrelated objects. We compare the predicted environment response with an execution-derived reference, using a hybrid architecture with both deterministic gates and a semantic judge. Among 20 general-purpose LLMs and specialized text world models, GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest task success rate at 49.57%. We find that model accuracy decreases as actions affect a larger portion of the environment. Specifically, when the agent's changes must propagate to dependent objects, task success drops to an average of 5.1% across all 20 models. Although model strengths differ across tasks, 631 tasks remain unsolved by any model, suggesting a significant gap in general LLM capabilities as a world model.

</details>


### [385] [LEMON: Equivariant Learning over Attention Maps for Zero-Shot Misbehavior Monitoring on New LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22723)
*Guy Bar-Shalom,Mor Geva,Fabrizio Frasca,Haggai Maron*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出LEMON，一个基于图神经网络的在线监控器，利用几何深度学习原理使预测对跨模型注意力图的代数对称性不变，实现零样本跨LLM的幻觉与越狱检测，在16个模型、6个数据集上优于所有基线最多14个AUC点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在高风险场景中的失效需要监控，外部LLM监控成本过高；基于内部表征的探针虽高效但绑定特定模型，新模型出现时需重新标注。因此希望构建可零样本跨模型迁移的内部表征监控器，但跨模型的注意力图在头功能、顺序、深度上不一致，难以直接迁移。

Method: 将跨模型注意力失配刻画为代数对称性（头置换、重排、深度变化等），并基于几何深度学习原理设计LEMON——一种在线图神经网络监控器，其预测对这些对称变换不变。LEMON逐token处理生成的注意力图，每token（或每W个token窗口）输出一个分数，开销可忽略。

Result: 在16个LLM和6个数据集上，零样本跨模型设定下，LEMON在幻觉监控和越狱监控两类任务上均优于所有基线，相比最强基线提升最多14个ROC-AUC点。

Conclusion: 通过将跨模型注意力不匹配视为对称性并用等变GNN建模，可有效实现零样本跨模型内部表征监控，为低成本、可迁移的LLM失效检测提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Large language models exhibit misbehaviors that hinder deployment in high-stakes settings. One approach to monitor such failures is to use an external LLM as a monitor, but this is prohibitively expensive. A well-known and efficient class of monitors can detect such failures from internal representations (such as activation probes), but are tied to the model they were trained on, requiring costly re-annotation as new LLMs appear. A natural way to avoid this repeated annotation cost is to develop internal-representation based monitors that transfer zero-shot across LLMs. However, such transfer is challenging because internal representations are not naturally aligned across models; in particular, attention maps, known to contain signals of misbehavior, may differ in head function, ordering, and model depth. In this work, we characterize those cross-model attention mismatches as algebraic symmetries and use geometric deep learning principles to build LEMON (Language-model Equivariant MOnitoring Network) an online graph neural network-based monitor, whose predictions are invariant under these symmetries. LEMON processes attention maps token-by-token, as they are produced and outputs a score after every token (or every window of $W$ tokens) at negligible cost. Across 16 LLMs and six datasets, in the zero-shot cross-model setting, LEMON outperforms all baselines on both hallucination and jailbreak monitoring tasks, improving over the strongest by up to 14 ROC-AUC points.

</details>


### [386] [Graph Serializations for Reasoning LLMs: A Study Across Knowledge Extraction and Structural Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22734)
*Julien Yu,Mihaela Bornea,Avirup Sil,Katrin Kirchhoff*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 评估15种知识图谱序列化格式在9种前沿LLM配置下于知识抽取与结构推理任务上的表现，发现抽取任务对格式不敏感，而结构推理准确率显著依赖格式选择，最优格式随模型、查询与任务而变，应将序列化视为动态编排决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究指出图谱文本序列化格式可使LLM性能相差数十个百分点，但仅覆盖有限表征形式，且未涉及具备更强推理、指令遵循与长上下文能力的前沿推理模型，故需重新系统评估。

Method: 选取15种图表示格式，在9种前沿LLM配置上，针对本体知识抽取与结构化图推理两类任务进行对比评测。

Result: 知识抽取任务对序列化格式相对不敏感；结构化推理任务的准确率受格式选择显著影响，最优格式取决于具体模型、查询与任务。

Conclusion: 不存在普适最优的图序列化格式，应把图谱序列化视为一种依据模型、查询和任务动态编排的决策。

Abstract: The way a knowledge graph is serialized as text for inclusion into LLM context can substantially affect downstream LLM performance, with prior work reporting tens of percentage points variations across formats. However, existing studies consider only a limited set of representations and predate frontier reasoning models, which now offer stronger reasoning, instruction-following, and long-context capabilities. We evaluate 15 graph representation formats across nine frontier LLM configurations on ontology-based knowledge extraction and structural graph reasoning tasks. While knowledge extraction is relatively insensitive to different serialization formats, the choice of the optimal format for structural reasoning tasks significantly affects accuracy. We demonstrate that the optimal representation choice depends on model, query, and task and propose to approach graph serialization as a dynamic orchestration decision.

</details>


### [387] [R$^2$Orch: Recursive Self-Improvement for Agent Orchestration via Self-Play within a Skill-Internalization Loop](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22740)
*Mingda Zhang,Yun Huang,Qiang Huang,Yanjin Li,Rui Qian,Qichao Zhao,Tiesunlong Shen,Na Zhao,Jian Wang,Xiaoying Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: R²Orch 提出递归自博弈编排范式：内环在自选任务上自博弈提升编排器，外环改进内环的改进方式；用“递归可学习性”奖励 Proposer 选出让候选结果持续多样的任务，并用“技能撤回”估计并移除冗余技能，最终趋向零技能部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 agentic 编排学习存在三大问题：依赖人工设计的课程；某任务的所有 rollout 结果相同导致优势塌缩；用单一噪声分数评判每个技能，评估信号不可靠。

Method: 提出 R²Orch 范式：内环为自博弈，编排器在自选任务上训练；外环优化内环的学习过程。引入 Recursive Learnability 训练目标，奖励 Proposer 选择“随着技能被撤回，rollout 结果仍持续不一致”的任务。基于该目标提出 Skill Withdrawal：当自博弈内的受控评估显示去掉某技能后表现不变即撤回该技能。两环形成闭环：失败蒸馏为技能、技能压缩为参数、撤回驱动 Proposer 寻找新的失败。

Result: 在十二个数据集上的实验表明，R²Orch 在问答、数学、代码与交互类任务上一致优于基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过递归自博弈与技能撤回机制，R²Orch 自发构建课程、缓解优势塌缩并基于更可靠的评估决定技能去留，推动编排器向零技能部署演进。

Abstract: In recent years, agentic orchestration has been widely applied to solve complex human tasks. However, existing orchestration learning still faces key challenges, including hand-designed curricula, advantage collapse when a task's rollouts all reach the same outcome, and unreliable evaluation signals that judge each skill by one noisy score.
